Advanced packaging should also be more equipment-intensive than conventional
packaging, providing a second leg to the equipment thesis. The transition toward

2.5D/3D integration requires additional and increasingly sophisticated process steps,
including fine-pitch RDL, TSV, wafer-level processing, temporary bonding/debonding, high-
precision die placement, thermal compression/hybrid bonding and advanced inspection. As
interconnect pitches shrink and package complexity increases, equipment performance
becomes increasingly critical to yield and throughput. We therefore expect equipment
value per unit of packaging capacity to rise as the domestic industry migrates from

conventional packaging toward 2.5D and ultimately 3D integration.

ACM Research (ACMR.O, OW): ACM Research is one of the more direct beneficiaries of
China’s advanced-packaging capacity build-out because its portfolio addresses several
process steps whose equipment intensity rises materially in wafer-level, 2.5D/3D and
panel-level packaging, particularly electrochemical plating, cleaning and other wet

processes. The exposure is already showing up in reported results: in Q2 2026, ACM’s
advanced-packaging revenue excluding ECP grew 153% YoY, while its ECP, furnace and
other technologies category grew 168% YoY, with management citing ECP and advanced
packaging as the key growth drivers. ACM shipped its 2,000th ECP chamber during the
quarter, demonstrating an increasingly meaningful installed base across logic, memory and
3D packaging. More importantly for the China capacity-build thesis, ACM received its first

production order for a 510×515mm horizontal panel-level electroplating system from an
existing advanced-packaging customer in mainland China, moving its panel-level offering
closer to volume production. As Chinese OSATs and integrated manufacturers expand
2.5D/3D, fan-out and eventually larger-format panel-level packaging, ACM should benefit
from both additional tool demand and increasing process intensity per package, while its
local manufacturing, application-development and service infrastructure should support

further localization-driven share gains.
ASMPT (0522.HK, OW):  ASMPT should be a major beneficiary of China’s advanced-
packaging investment through its leading positions in thermo-compression bonding (TCB),

16
high-precision flip-chip die bonding and hybrid bonding, technologies that become
increasingly critical as AI processors migrate toward larger 2.5D packages, chiplets, HBM
and higher-density 3D integration. The operating momentum is already substantial:
ASMPT’s TCB revenue grew approximately 146% YoY in 2025, while its advanced-
packaging business reached a record US$339 million of revenue in 1H 2026, up 17% YoY
and representing 30% of group revenue. In July 2026, it received bulk orders for more

than 50 chip-to-substrate TCB tools from OSAT customers, highlighting the step-up in
equipment requirements as compound die sizes increase for AI workloads. China provides
an additional demand vector: ASMPT has reported particularly strong Chinese demand for
die- and wire-bonding equipment as domestic AI infrastructure investment and OSAT

toward larger packages, finer-pitch interconnects, chip-on-wafer/chip-on-panel

architectures and ultimately more TCB and hybrid bonding, equipment value per unit of
packaging capacity should rise, creating a favorable mix shift toward ASMPT’s highest-
value advanced bonding platforms.
Other major domestic Chinese equipment companies: These span nearly the full
advanced-packaging process flow. Circuit Fabology Microelectronics Equipment, or
CFMEE (688630.SH; 9630.HK; not covered), provides direct-write lithography for RDL,
bumping, TSV and system-on-wafer applications. Its wafer-level packaging tools have

architectures, while its large-format panel-level lithography platform has progressed into
customer qualification and commercial orders. Kingsemi (688037.SH; not covered)
supplies coat/develop, wafer cleaning, temporary bonding and laser debonding systems
specifically designed for advanced packaging and 2.5D/3D integration, giving it exposure to
thick-photoresist RDL processes, TSV cleaning and the temporary bond/debond steps

required for aggressive wafer thinning. Hwatsing Technology (688120.SH; not covered) is
leveraged to CMP, ultra-precision wafer thinning, dicing and wet processing, with its
thinning equipment already receiving orders in advanced-memory and Chiplet applications;
these steps become increasingly demanding as wafers and dies are thinned for stacked
architectures. Skyverse Technology (688361.SH; not covered) provides inspection and
metrology equipment, including 3D topography measurement capable of monitoring fine-

line RDL and TSV-related processes for HBM and 2.5D/3D packaging, a business which
could grow through the increase in process-control intensity as package complexity rises.
Piotech (688072.SH; not covered) is exposed to the next stage of packaging localization
through wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer hybrid bonding, surface activation and bonding
metrology. Its product portfolio explicitly targets HBM and 3D integration as China moves
from conventional packaging localization toward domestic production of the most

advanced bonding steps. Collectively, the industry  should benefit from the absolute
increase in Chinese advanced-packaging capacity and the rising number, precision and
value of process steps required per package as the industry migrates toward Chiplets,
HBM, 2.5D/3D integration and panel-level packaging.
BE Semiconductor (BESI.AS, OW, covered by Nigel van Putten): Besi is particularly well

Debate 3: Besides 2.5D packaging, how much upside can
emerging advanced-packaging technologies contribute to
China OSATs?
Market view: 3DIC, HBM packaging, CPO could be meaningful drivers. The
market is increasingly pricing in meaningful incremental opportunities for Chinese
OSATs from next-generation packaging technologies including 3DIC, HBM and CPO,
with each potentially creating a sizable new revenue pool as domestic AI

infrastructure scales.
Our view:  More cautious on the near-term earnings contribution. While all three
technologies are strategically important, we believe commercialization remains
constrained by either cost, customer ownership of packaging, or technology
maturity. As a result, we see the current advanced-packaging earnings story as
being driven primarily by 2.5D/CoWoS-type capacity expansion, while 3DIC, HBM
and CPO remain mostly medium- to long-term optionality.

Metrics to monitor: 1) Customer qualification and volume-production milestones;
2) dedicated capacity additions; 3) utilization rates; and 4) disclosed revenue
contribution from these new technologies.
Where we could be wrong: 1) OSAT technology breakthrough which lower the
cost of 3DIC; 2) accelerating HBM outsourcing together with OSAT HBM packaging
capability improvement; 3) CPO yield improves faster than expected together with
OSAT CPO packaging capability improvement.

3DIC
3DIC – China could over-index in adoption, but high cost remains the key constraint.
TSMC remains the global leader in 3DIC through its SoIC platform, although SoIC capacity
is still small relative to its CoWoS footprint. AMD and Apple are the major customers of
TSMC SoIC capacity with Nvidia's share increasing next year. China, meanwhile, is seeing a
growing number of early 3DIC implementations across edge AI and mobile.
• Rockchip’s RK1820 integrates high-bandwidth on-chip DRAM with an NPU, with

industry sources describing the memory implementation as a 3D-stacked
architecture;
• Xiaomi’s recently announced XRING O100 AI accelerator reportedly uses 6nm
wafer-to-wafer stacking and hybrid bonding to deliver 1.22TB/s memory bandwidth
• Dongfang Suanxin’s DF1000 adopts DRAM-on-logic wafer-level hybrid bonding for
near-memory AI computing.
•  Huawei launched the Kirin 9050 Pro in September 2026 for the Mate XT 2, the
first high-performance processor to use logic folding technology. The design stacks

logic units across layers and connects them vertically, shortening signal paths to
reduce latency and improve performance.

### Page 19

M
Asia Pacific Insight
Morgan Stanley Research 19
We view Kirin 9050 Pro as potentially the most meaningful domestic proof point given its
deployment in a commercial flagship smartphone, the annual sell-through of Huawei Mate
XT (using Kirin 9020 chip) is around 300-400k unit in past year. Therefore, we estimate
China’s 3DIC market will remain at only tens of millions of US dollars over the next 2–3
years. A meaningful expansion in TAM would require either tens of millions of units in

consumer electronics applications or million-unit volumes of high-ASP AI accelerators.
Exhibit 21: LogicFolding for Huawei's mobile SoC
Source:  Huawei.
The key limitation, in our view, is cost. A true 3D logic stack adds substantially more
manufacturing content than conventional packaging: additional active dies/wafers must be
fabricated and tested, followed by wafer thinning, CMP/surface preparation, TSV or
backside interconnect processing, high-precision alignment, hybrid bonding and

significantly more inspection/metrology. More importantly, the economics are highly
sensitive to compound yield—a defective die or poor bond can destroy value already
embedded in another known-good die. Industry cost studies therefore identify incoming
wafer cost and yield loss as major drivers of 3D hybrid-bonding economics, rather than the
bonding tool itself. This makes 3DIC very different from conventional OSAT packaging.
The package is increasingly incorporating fab-like process steps and expensive processed

silicon, meaning the absolute packaging/integration cost can rise materially even if hybrid-
bonding unit costs decline with scale. This is also why global adoption has so far
concentrated in products for which performance per watt, bandwidth or form factor can
justify the premium—AMD HPC/AI, Apple’s high-end M-series and, increasingly, high-value
AI accelerators—rather than broad-based semiconductor applications.

China could nevertheless adopt 3DIC more aggressively than global economics alone

This is particularly relevant in China, where restricted access to EUV and leading-edge

process technology makes architectural and packaging workarounds comparatively more
valuable.
HBM
HBM – strong volume opportunity, but limited incremental value capture for OSATs
for now. HBM is arguably the largest potential packaging-related demand pool given rapid
AI accelerator growth, but the key debate is who captures the packaging value. CXMT is
currently developing domestic HBM capabilities. In our CXMT initiation report, we
estimate CXMT can produce 3-4mn units of HBM3E stacks in 2027. However, packaging is

currently largely retained within the memory ecosystem, including through affiliated
packaging capabilities such as Xinputianying, limiting the immediate addressable market
for independent OSATs. Outsourcing could increase as technology matures and volumes
scale, but we would view this primarily as a volume-transfer opportunity rather than a
major structural uplift in OSAT value capture unless independent OSATs are able to take
on higher-value TSV / stacking / advanced integration steps.

CPO – attractive long-term TAM, but unlikely to move near-term earnings. CPO could

migrate toward higher-bandwidth and lower-power optical interconnects. However, the
technology remains relatively immature, with fiber alignment, thermal management,
testing and supply-chain integration still key bottlenecks. Industry forecasts generally
point to initial volume production beginning around 2026, but large-scale deployment is
more likely in 2027–28, suggesting limited contribution to China OSAT earnings over the
next 1–2 years. We therefore see CPO as a credible long-term optionality rather than a

near-term earnings catalyst.

JCET to emerge as a meaningful share gainer in China’s 2.5D/CoWoS-like advanced
packaging.
• JCET is effectively building its 2.5D business from a low base, leaving substantial
room for incremental share gains in a market currently highly concentrated: SJ
Semiconductor (SJSemi) held c.85% of China’s 2.5D packaging market by revenue in

2024. JCET Microelectronics (Jiangyin), the group’s key high-end advanced
packaging facility, only began volume ramp-up recently, but the trajectory is
encouraging. Revenue reached Rmb212mn in 1H26, while net losses narrowed to
Rmb89mn, with utilization continuing to improve. Management expects the
business to turn profitable in 2027, while we estimate capacity could reach
~5kwpm by end-2027, providing meaningful headroom for 2.5D revenue and share

expansion.
• Customer visibility is improving: JCET  already has an anchor CSP customer, while
qualification and ramp-up with additional customers are progressing. Management
has highlighted a rich pipeline of customer projects and expects the Jiangyin 2.5D
business to scale to Rmb billions of annual revenue over the next 1–2 years.
•  JCET is broadening its advanced-packaging footprint beyond its existing Jiangyin
capacity. The recently announced Rmb7.8bn high-end advanced packaging facility in

Shanghai Lingang should provide a second leg of capacity growth, with the
company also building capabilities across CPO, panel-level packaging, 2.5D/3D
integration and other next-generation technologies.
Taken together, we see JCET transitioning from a relatively small participant to an
increasingly scaled supplier in domestic 2.5D advanced packaging, supported by capacity
ramp, customer diversification and technology expansion, which should translate into

structural market-share gains over the medium to long term.

Domestic market share gain driven by mix upgrade, rather than price-led competition.

In 2025, JCET’s China revenue increased ~22% YoY to Rmb8.3bn,  outpacing domestic
revenue growth at key OSAT peers, including Tongfu Microelectronics at 15% YoY  and
Huatian Technology at 18% YoY. More importantly, JCET achieved this above-peer growth
alongside a 6.6ppt YoY expansion in domestic gross margin to 20.4%, versus only modest
margin improvement at Huatian and broadly flat/down margins at Tongfu. This
combination of accelerating revenue growth and sharply improving profitability suggests

that JCET is not gaining share through aggressive pricing. Rather, we believe it points to
structural share gains in higher-value-added segments such as computing, automotive, and
industrial applications.

JCET: Valuation methodology
We raise our price target to Rmb90.2: This reflects the changes in our earnings estimates
and increased intermediate growth rate to 19.0% up from 13.5% mainly because of

increasing mix from AI-related advanced packaging. We continue to derive our price target
using the base-case value from a residual income (RI) model. All of our key assumptions
are unchanged, including a cost of equity of 8.6% (beta of 1.2, risk premium of 5.5%, and
risk-free rate of 2.0%), and a terminal growth rate of 4.0%.

SJ Semi: Leading advanced packaging player, with premium
valuation
We initiate coverage on SJ Semi with Equal-weight and a price target of Rmb118.4. SJ
Semi is a leading advanced packaging vendor in China and the No.1 player in domestic 2.5D
packaging, with c.77% market share in 2025. We expect the company to be a key
beneficiary of strong China AI GPU demand and increasing adoption of chiplet/
heterogeneous integration, driving 25% revenue CAGR over 2025-28, with a rising 2.5D

mix supporting a structurally superior margin profile versus domestic OSAT peers.
However, we see a more balanced risk-reward at current valuation. Aggressive capacity
expansion by domestic peers could pressure SJ Semi’s market share, pricing, and
utilization, while high customer concentration and potential bottlenecks in  HBM supply
add uncertainty to the pace of growth. We believe the stock’s premium valuation already
reflects its technology leadership and strong advanced-packaging growth outlook,

supporting our Equal-weight rating
Investment Positives
A key beneficiary of China’s advanced packaging growth. We see SJ Semi as a key
beneficiary of the rapid development of China’s AI computing ecosystem, in which
advanced packaging has become an increasingly critical part of the AI GPU supply chain as
chiplet architectures and heterogeneous integration gain adoption. According to CIC,
China’s advanced packaging market is expected to grow to Rmb100bn in 2029 at 13%

CAGR (2025-29), while the chiplet/multi-chip integration segment is expected to expand
to Rmb17.7bn in 2029 at 40% CAGR (2025-29). Beyond AI GPUs, advanced packaging
demand is also growing across data centers, autonomous driving, smartphones and
communications applications, providing SJ Semi with diversified structural growth drivers.
Given its leading position in China’s 2.5D packaging market, we expect SJ Semi to capture
this strong industry beta and deliver 25% revenue CAGR over 2025-28.

Leading domestic 3DIC commercialization with a clear first-mover advantage. We

believe SJ Semi is currently the most advanced among domestic OSAT peers in 3DIC, with

underlying process capabilities, we believe SJ Semi is ahead in 3DIC commercialization and
dedicated capacity deployment, supporting a meaningful first-mover advantage as
domestic 3DIC demand scales.

Investment Concerns
Intensifying competition in advanced packaging could pressure market share and

returns. While SJ Semiconductor currently holds a leading position in China’s advanced
packaging market, competition is likely to intensify as domestic OSAT peers, including
JCET, Tongfu Microelectronics, and Forehope Electronic, accelerate capacity expansion and
technology upgrades in advanced packaging. As competing capacity comes online and
peers narrow the technology gap, SJ Semiconductor could face greater pressure on
customer share, pricing and capacity utilization. In addition, aggressive industry-wide

capacity additions could increase the risk of oversupply, potentially weighing on margins
and returns on invested capital over the medium term.
High customer concentration creates a potential long-term risk. SJ Semiconductor has
significant revenue exposure to Huawei, ~74% in 1H25, making its earnings sensitive to
Huawei’s outsourcing strategy. Meanwhile, Huawei is developing its own advanced
packaging capabilities through Quliang and Ruixin. As these in-house platforms scale and

mature, Huawei could potentially shift part of its advanced packaging demand away from
external suppliers such as SJ Semiconductor. While this may not be an immediate risk
given capacity and technology constraints, greater internalization over time could reduce
SJ Semiconductor’s order visibility, utilization rates and bargaining power..

U.S. export controls remain a potential supply-chain  risk. SJ Semiconductor is currently
on the U.S. Entity List, which could restrict its access to certain U.S.-origin equipment,
components, software and technologies that require export licenses. While export
controls have historically focused more heavily on advanced front-end semiconductor

manufacturing equipment and SJ Semiconductor's exposure to restricted back-end
packaging equipment appears relatively manageable at present, the U.S. has continued to
broaden semiconductor-related controls. As advanced packaging becomes increasingly
critical to AI and advanced computing, there is a risk that future restrictions could expand
to cover additional advanced packaging equipment or technologies. If SJ Semiconductor's
overseas suppliers are unable to obtain required export licenses, or if localization of

relevant equipment and components progresses more slowly than expected, the company
could face disruptions to capacity expansion, production and R&D, potentially constraining
its technology roadmap and long-term growth.
Our estimates vs consensus
What's priced in? Since its listing on April 21, SJ Semi’s share price has been volatile,
initially rallying sharply through May 26 as strong investor enthusiasm around China’s
advanced packaging and AI supply-chain localization drove a significant valuation re-rating.

From late May through July 9, the shares entered a period of consolidation and elevated
volatility as investors digested the rapid post-IPO rerating and increasingly demanding
valuation, although continued enthusiasm around advanced packaging supported periodic
rebounds. The stock subsequently sold off alongside the broader global technology and
semiconductor correction in July, as concerns over elevated AI valuations and the
sustainability of the AI capex cycle drove a broad risk-off move across semiconductor

equities. Following SJ Semi’s 2Q26 results, with quarterly revenue growth slowing to c.2%
YoY and net profit declining 16% YoY; the stock fell  as results fell short of elevated
market expectations.

What is the market missing? We think the market is missing three factors:

• Intensifying competition which pressures the margin. OSAT peers were all
attracted by secular growth opportunities of advanced packaging. As peers ramp
up capacity, we expect a certain level of pricing competition. Therefore, our gross
margin assumptions are slightly lower than consensus numbers in 2028.
• HBM tightness and leading-node capacity ramp-up pace and yield. Although we
are constructive on China AI GPU shipment growth and local HBM ramp, any

hiccup in GPU production or HBM sourcing (local and foreign) will impact final
shipments and thus  constrain near-term growth and execution
• Over-estimation of 3DIC, HBM sourcing and CPO opportunities. We think
expectations for 3DIC, CPO and HBM outsourcing opportunities appear optimistic,
with the timing and addressable revenue pool likely overstated, for details, please
see  Debate 3: Besides 2.5D packaging, how much upside can emerging advanced-

packaging technologies contribute to China OSATs?

Peer comparison
We identify three peer groups for SJ Semi:  Execution needs to substantiate the high

premium over peers:
• OSAT peers:  We benchmark SJ Semi against domestic A-share OSATs and global
OSAT leaders, reflecting its core exposure to semiconductor packaging and testing.
However, SJ Semi's greater focus on wafer-level advanced packaging and 3D
integration supports a premium valuation versus conventional OSAT peers. We

### Page 35

M
Asia Pacific Insight
Morgan Stanley Research 35
expect the premium to narrow over the long term as the advanced packaging mix
increases at peers.
• China AI GPU thematic peers: We compare SJ Semi with China AI GPU players,
given its exposure to the domestic AI/HPC ecosystem through advanced packaging.
While not direct business-model peers, this group provides a useful valuation
reference for the scarcity premium and growth expectations attached to China's

localized AI compute supply chain. SJ Semi's 2027 P/S and P/E are higher than large
local GPU companies (Cambricon and Hygon) seems demanding, as the revenue
growth of GPU players is expected to be stronger.
• Back-end equipment: SJ Semi sits downstream as a manufacturing/service provider
rather than an equipment vendor, but both groups benefit from increasing
adoption of 2.5D/3D integration, fine-pitch interconnect and advanced bonding.
Overall back-end equipment valuations seem more reasonable vs. SJ Semi.

SJ Semi trades at 31x/24x/19x 2026-28E P/S,  far above OSATs (~3x/3x/2x) and equipment
peers (~11x/8x/8x), and much closer to China AI GPU supply chain names (~25x/15x/12x).
We think the current valuation already prices SJ Semi much more as an AI/advanced-
packaging scarcity asset than as an OSAT, so execution needs to substantiate that
premium.

SJ Semi: Earnings Growth Outlook
Revenue growth outlook:
• We forecast overall revenue to increase at a 25% CAGR in 2025-28.
• We expect chiplet/2.5D packaging to increase at a 36% CAGR in 2025-28, because
advanced packaging has become an increasingly critical part of the AI GPU supply
chain and chiplet architectures and as heterogeneous integration gain adoption.
• We expect mid level wafer processing business  to grow at 10% CAGR (2025-28),

driven by rising advanced-node wafer volumes and increasing outsourcing of
bumping, probing and other mid-end processes as packaging complexity increases .
•  We expect SJ Semi’s WLP business to grow at a more moderate 5% CAGR over
2025–28, as this segment is more exposed to smartphone relate chips such as
Radio Frequency (RF), fingerprint chips.
Earnings growth outlook: We expect SJ semi's earnings to grow at a 34% CAGR (2025-
28), outpacing its sales growth. While the company still needs to invest heavily in capex to

expand its capacity and  R&D for technology upgrades, we expect operating leverage to
emerge as revenue scales significantly.
GM trend: We expect the company’s gross margin to improve from 31% in 2025 to 32% in
2028, due to an increasing contribution from chiplet/2.5D packaging which carries
structurally higher margins. We anticipate SJ Semi to maintain technology leadership in
advanced packaging and China AI GPU demand to remain strong for next 3-5 years.

Therefore, SJ Semi's gross margin could improve mildly as capacity scales, but partly offset
by increasing competition as peers also ramp-up capacity.

Valuation Methodology
Our price target is Rmb118.4: We derive our price target from a residual income model, as
we believe this methodology is best suited to capturing long-term value. We assume an
8.0% cost of equity (beta 1.09, risk-free rate 2.0% and risk premium 5.5%), a payout ratio
of 50%, a medium-term growth rate of 26.0%, and a terminal growth rate of 5.0%, all of
which are in line with other China AI supply chain companies under our coverage.

Our price target implies 11.0x 2026 book value per share,  2.3x  the local OSAT peer
average. We think  its premium valuation already discounts much of SJ Semi's technology
leadership and AI-driven growth.

Bull/bear case discussion

Our bull case value is Rmb200: stronger revenue growth with accelerated gross
margin expansion
We assume (1) >40% revenue CAGR in 2025-28 driven by stronger-than-expected
domestic AI GPU demand; (2) limited competition risk as peers struggle to ramp up
advanced packaging capacity; and (3) gross margin above 35% in 2026-28 thanks to
production scale effects and technology breakthrough.
Our bear case value is Rmb80: slower revenue growth with gross margin erosion amid

intensifying competition
We assume (1) <20% revenue CAGR in 2025-28 given slower-than-expected domestic AI
GPU demand; (2) significant market share loss in China’s advanced packaging market as
peers scale capacity; and (3) gross margin below 25% in 2026 and 2027 due to strong
price competition and underutilized capacity.

SJ Semi: Company Profile
Established in 2014, SJ Semiconductor  is one of the leading advanced semiconductor
packaging and testing companies in China, focusing on wafer-level advanced packaging and
mid-end wafer processing. The company is among the earliest domestic providers of 12-
inch bumping services and has expanded into wafer-level packaging (WLP) and Chiplet-
based heterogeneous integration solutions. SJ Semiconductor provides end-to-end

advanced packaging services covering bumping, wafer probing, wafer-level packaging,
2.5D/3DIC, and advanced heterogeneous integration technologies for high-performance
computing, AI, data center, automotive and mobile applications. The company completed
its IPO on the Shanghai STAR Market in April 2026.
Business overview
SJ Semiconductor specializes in advanced packaging and wafer-level manufacturing
technologies. Its major technology platforms include:

• Mid-end wafer processing, including 12-inch bumping, redistribution layer (RDL),
wafer probing (CP), TSV and hybrid bonding;
• Wafer-level packaging (WLP), including fan-in WLCSP and advanced wafer-level
packaging solutions;
• Chiplet heterogeneous integration, including 2.5D integration (TSV interposer),
3DIC and 3D Package technologies targeting AI accelerators, HPC processors,
networking chips and other high-performance applications.
Key Competitors

SJ Semi ranked number 9 in the global OSAT market in terms of revenue in 2025 with a
market share of 1.9%, according to Gartner.  Major international competitors include ASE
Technology and  Amkor Technology. Major domestic competitors include JCET, Tongfu
Microelectronics, Tianshui Huatian Technology, and Forehope Electronics.

Key   customers and COGS 
SJ Semiconductor provides advanced packaging services primarily for leading fabless 
semiconductor companies, foundries and HPC customers. As of 1H25, the top 5 customers 
accounted for 91% of sales, and top 1 customer Huawei accounts for 74% of total revenue.  
SJ Semi's revenue is primarily from China customers; overseas revenue accounted for 6% 
of total revenue in 1H25. 
Manufacturing cost accounted for 50% of COGS in 1H25. Advanced packaging requires 
high levels of clean room, precision, and automation, thus it requires a significant amount 
of advanced  packaging and testing equipment. This equipment and these production lines 
are typically highly expensive, so manufacturing cost usually accounts for a high 
proportion of the operating cost structure.

Technology Venture capital (9.39%), an industry investment fund backed by stated-owned

SJ Semiconductor  was originally established in 2014 as a joint venture between

Glossary
2.5D: 2.5-Dimensional Integration. Advanced packaging architecture that places multiple
dies, such as AI processors and HBM, side-by-side on an interposer or equivalent high-
density interconnect platform.
3DIC: Three-Dimensional Integrated Circuit. Advanced integration architecture that
vertically stacks dies to increase compute density and shorten interconnects, but with
higher process complexity, cost and yield sensitivity.

ASIC: Application-Specific Integrated Circuit. Chip designed for a specific workload or
application, including custom AI accelerators.
Back-end: Back-end Semiconductor Manufacturing. Semiconductor assembly, packaging
and testing processes performed after wafer fabrication. Advanced packaging is making
these processes increasingly complex and equipment-intensive.
Bumping: Wafer Bumping. Process of forming conductive bumps on a wafer or die to
create electrical connections to another die, interposer or substrate.

C2W: Chip-to-Wafer. 3D integration approach in which individual dies are bonded onto a
wafer, allowing tested dies to be selected before stacking.
Chiplet: A smaller functional die designed to be integrated with other dies within one
package, enabling system performance to scale without relying solely on larger monolithic
chips.
CMP: Chemical Mechanical Planarization. Precision polishing process used to create
extremely flat wafer surfaces, important for advanced 3D integration and hybrid bonding.

CoWoS: Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate. Family of 2.5D advanced packaging architectures
that integrates multiple compute and memory dies through high-density interconnects.
CoWoS-L: Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate – Local Silicon Interconnect 2.5D architecture
combining an RDL-based interposer with local silicon interconnects, offering greater
scalability and design flexibility for larger AI packages.
CoWoS-S: Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate – Silicon Interposer 2.5D architecture using a

full silicon interposer to connect multiple dies.
CP: Chip Probe Electrical testing of individual dies while they remain on the wafer, helping
identify functional dies before downstream packaging.
CPO: Co-Packaged Optics Integration of optical communication components close to
compute or switching chips to increase interconnect bandwidth and reduce power
consumption.
CSP: Cloud Service Provider Large cloud-computing customer that operates data-center

infrastructure and is an important source of demand for AI accelerators and advanced
packaging.
Dicing: Wafer Dicing Process of cutting a processed wafer into individual semiconductor
dies.

### Page 48

M
Asia Pacific Insight
48
ECP: Electrochemical Plating Process that electrochemically deposits conductive metals,
typically copper, for structures including RDL and TSV-related interconnects.
EUV: Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography Advanced lithography technology used in leading-
edge semiconductor wafer fabrication.
Fab: Semiconductor Fabrication Plant Manufacturing facility in which semiconductor
wafers are processed and chips are fabricated.
Fabless: Fabless Semiconductor Company Semiconductor company that designs chips

but outsources wafer manufacturing to foundries.
Fan-in: Fan-in Wafer-Level Packaging Wafer-level packaging architecture in which
package interconnections remain within the footprint of the original die.
Fan-out: Fan-out Packaging Packaging architecture that redistributes connections beyond
the original die footprint, enabling more I/O connections and potentially multi-die
integration.
Fine Pitch: Fine Interconnect Pitch Small spacing between electrical interconnects. Finer

pitch enables higher interconnect density and bandwidth but requires greater
manufacturing precision.
Flip Chip: Flip-Chip Packaging Packaging method in which a die is flipped face-down and
electrically connected through bumps rather than conventional wire bonds.
Foundry: Semiconductor Foundry Manufacturer that fabricates semiconductor wafers for
chip designers and other customers.
Front-end: Front-end Semiconductor Manufacturing Wafer-fabrication processes used

to create transistors and circuitry before semiconductor assembly and packaging.
GPU: Graphics Processing Unit Highly parallel processor widely used for AI workloads
and a key source of demand for 2.5D/3D advanced packaging.
HBM: High-Bandwidth Memory Vertically stacked DRAM positioned close to AI
processors to provide very high memory bandwidth. HBM availability can constrain AI
accelerator and advanced-packaging output.
HBM3E / HBM4 / HBM4E: High-Bandwidth Memory Generations Successive generations

of HBM with increasing bandwidth, capacity and packaging complexity.
Heterogeneous Integration Integration of different types of dies, potentially
manufactured using different process technologies, into a single package or system.
HPC: High-Performance Computing Compute-intensive applications requiring high
processing performance and memory bandwidth, making them major users of advanced
packaging.
Hybrid Bonding: High-density bonding technology that directly connects metal

interconnects and dielectric surfaces between dies or wafers, enabling finer interconnect
pitch for advanced 3D integration.
Interposer: Intermediate layer connecting multiple dies within a package through high-
density electrical interconnects; commonly used in 2.5D packaging.

### Page 49

M
Asia Pacific Insight
Morgan Stanley Research 49
KGD: Known-Good Die: Die that has been tested and confirmed functional before being
incorporated into a multi-die package, helping reduce yield-related losses.
Logic Folding: Huawei's logic-stacking approach that uses vertical integration to shorten
signal paths and increase effective transistor density through system-, circuit- and
packaging-level innovation.
Micro-bump: Very small conductive bump used to create fine-pitch electrical connections

between dies in advanced packages.
NPU: Neural Processing Unit Processor optimized specifically for neural-network and AI
workloads.
OSAT: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test Semiconductor service provider
specializing in chip assembly, packaging and testing. JCET, SJ Semi, ASE and Amkor are
examples discussed in the report.
Panel-Level Packaging: Packaging approach that processes semiconductor packages on
large rectangular panels rather than conventional circular wafers, potentially improving

manufacturing efficiency and cost at scale.
RDL: Redistribution Layer Fine metal wiring layers that redistribute electrical
connections between dies, bumps and other package components.
Singulation Package / Die Singulation Process of separating individual semiconductor
dies or packages from a processed wafer or panel.
SoC: System-on-Chip Semiconductor integrating multiple system functions, such as
processing, memory control and I/O, onto a single chip.

SoIC: System on Integrated Chips TSMC's 3D integration platform for vertically stacking
semiconductor dies using high-density interconnect technologies.
TCB: Thermo-Compression Bonding Precision bonding process that uses heat and
pressure to connect dies, increasingly important for HBM and advanced 2.5D/3D
packaging.
TSV: Through-Silicon Via Vertical electrical connection passing through silicon, enabling
high-density connections through interposers or vertically stacked dies.

UTR: Utilization Rate Proportion of installed manufacturing capacity that is actually being
used. A key measure of advanced-packaging supply-demand balance.
W2W: Wafer-to-Wafer 3D integration approach in which two complete wafers are aligned
and bonded before being diced into individual devices.
Wafer Thinning: Wafer Thinning / Grinding Process of reducing wafer thickness, enabling
thinner dies and tighter vertical stacking in HBM and 3D packages.

WLCSP: Wafer-Level Chip-Scale Package Wafer-level packaging in which the completed
package is approximately the same size as the semiconductor die.
WLPL Wafer-Level Packaging Packaging process performed while semiconductor dies
remain part of the wafer rather than after individual die singulation.
XDFOI: XDFOI Advanced Packaging Platform JCET's advanced packaging platform used

### Page 50

M
Asia Pacific Insight
50
for high-density and heterogeneous integration applications.

### Page 1

ab 15 September 2026
Global Research
First Read
Global Unichip
2026 Taiwan Summit:  CPU momentum and
ADAS projects support 2027F outlook
FY26 revenue outlook revised higher on improved wafer support
GUC attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. August revenue of NT$5,840mn
(+1%MoM/+111%YoY) is tracking above at 73%/75% of UBSe/Street +15%/+11%
QoQ. Following better-than-expected wafer support from TSMC, management raised its
FY26 revenue growth guidance from 36% YoY to approximately 100% in late-July, with

turnkey revenue expected to grow by over 100% and NRE revenue by high teens %.
Management maintained its 2026 corporate GM target of 20%+, despite rising revenue
contribution from its top  CPU customer. OPEX is expected to increase by high teens %
YoY, due to the new Turing center and higher employee bonuses, but strong revenue
growth should still drive meaningful operating leverage.
CPU project supports near-term growth and deepen CSP engagement

CPU turnkey project for the top CSP remains the main growth driver in H226F,
supported by increased wafer allocations for both the CPU project and GUC’s other top
customers. While the current CPU project carries a relatively lower margin given leading
CSP's extensive in-house design efforts, it has also strengthened GUC's customer
relationships. This has helped it secure the next-generation dual-die  CPU project, which
carries higher content and ASP and  should see initial revenue from late-2026 with more

significant revenue contribution in 2027E. GUC is also pursuing ASIC  accelerator
opportunities with the top CSP customer and the other major CSPs, although
management does not expect meaningful turnkey revenue before 2028.
Broader customer exposure supports medium-term growth
Beyond the current CPU ramp, GUC sees incremental growth opportunities across
ADAS, other CSP CPU/ASIC business, and CPO. Chinese customers'  ADAS turnkey
revenue is expected to begin in late 2026F, followed by a its U.S. 3nm ADAS project in

H227F, with both carrying higher margins than the current CPU program, although the
U.S. customer's ramp will depend on TSMC's capacity support. For the other CSP
customer, management expects revenue contribution from both CPU and ASIC   to begin
in H226F and could become another key  revenue driver in 2027. It is also working with
this CSP customer for Gen 3 and bidding on Gen 4 project. Although  CPO remains at an
early stage, GUC and its partners plan for  tape out  on TSMC’s COUPE by end-2026,

offering longer-term margin support given GUC’s greater involvement in chip design.
Valuation: Maintain Buy rating with a P/E-based price target of NT$6,700
We rate GUC BUY with a PT of  NT$6,700, based on 50x average 2027-28E EPS (vs
historical 15-62x range), supported by 52% CAGR in earnings over 2025-30E. We
reiterate that GUC should benefit from Google CPU upside and multiple automotive
project ramps.

Company Description
Global Unichip (GUC) is a leading IC design service company in Taiwan, founded in 1998. The
company's business is to design chipsets for customers that do not have IC design capability,
with the goal of reducing entry barriers and risks for chipset design and shortening the time

to market. The company's target to enable more IC design for start-ups and system
companies is complimentary with TSMC, which would benefit from a growing customer and
application base, in addition to the company's existing IC design and IDM customers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Global Unichip based on a PE methodology.
Downside risks include a slower-than-expected business recovery for mature node, lack of
new project wins, and wafer capacity constraints.

underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

壹、投 資 建 議

一.漲價轉嫁與高毛利訂單出貨，2Q26 稅後 EPS 3.11 元 
上品主要產品為氟素樹脂「鐵氟龍」半成品材料生產、內襯設備
加工及工程服務，半導體應用佔比近 9 成。2Q26 營收 13.0 億元，
QoQ 23.0%，YoY 0%；營業毛利 4.7 億元，QoQ 25.6%，YoY -5.2%，
毛利率 35.6%較去年同期下降 1.74 個百分點，主係部分出貨來自
去年景氣相對疲弱時接下的訂單，議價空間受限、毛利率偏低，
隨著下半年漲價轉嫁與高毛利訂單陸續出貨，預計毛利率將回
升；營業利益 3.0 億元，QoQ 42.3%，YoY -15.1%，營益率 23.0%；
稅後純益 2.5 億元，QoQ 23.4%，YoY 13.0%，純益率 19.1%，稅後
EPS 3.11 元。

7 月營收 5.3 億元，MoM 12.0%，YoY 47.7%；1-7 月累計營收 28.9
億元，YoY 9.6%。

二. 半導體建廠帶動的化學品供應 ， 訂單能見度至 28 年 
產品組合方面，內襯裝置佔 68.3%；其他材料與內襯管路分別佔
16.7% 與 9.6%；工程收入佔 5.4%。內襯裝置部分，隨著先進製程
對 particle(顆粒污染)、metal contamination(金屬污染)的要求越來越
嚴格，上品的材料升級能力可以配合 2 奈米以下製程需求，從原
料端到終端裝置完整供應。

上品中國市場營收佔比約 44.8% ，中國市場毛利率 33% ，略低於台
灣的 36%，對整體獲利結構的影響較高。台灣市場佔比約 49.3%，
受半導體產業發展持續帶動，持續有大量專案進行中；美國市場
主要客戶二廠槽車專案，從每月 80 台提升到 140 台，目前洽談訂
單已有 400 餘輛，其中 100 台已下訂並準備運往美國，預估今年
ISO tank 出貨量將較去年同期成長 80%至 90%，需求強勁。

三. 預估 2026 / 2027 稅後 EPS 12.5 / 14.5 元

中出貨帶動，7 月營收已突破 5 億元，預計下半年表現優於上半

16.9%，毛利率 35.7%；營業利益 11.8 億元，稅後純益 10.0 億元，
稅後 EPS 12.5 元。

歷史本益比區間 ， 目前本益比 15.6 倍評價合理 ， 故投資建議為 「買
進」，目標價 275 元（19 x 2027 EPS）。

貳、公 司 概 況

一. 公司簡介 
上品綜合工業股份有限公司（簡稱：上品；代號：4770）成立於
1981 年，總部位於台灣彰化，為全球少數具備從氟素樹脂原料加
工、半成品製造到內襯設備整合能力的一條龍供應商。公司核心
產品涵蓋氟素內襯設備、內襯管件及應用材料，廣泛應用於半導
體及電子級化學品產業的高純化學品儲存、輸送與製程系統，並
服務面板、石化等高腐蝕性化學環境應用領域。上品透過垂直整
合掌握關鍵原料與製程，能提供完整的客製化解決方案，確保產
品在耐腐蝕性、潔淨度及可靠性上的領先水準。公司於台灣彰濱
設有生產基地與研發中心，在中國浙江嘉興及美國亞利桑那均設
有百分之百持股子公司，結合當地業務與工程服務團隊，支援全
球客戶的建廠與設備需求。

截至 2026 年，半導體與電子化學品產業為上品營收主力，合計貢
獻超過八成，客戶涵蓋晶圓製造與先進化學品大廠。隨全球先進
製程擴產與電子級化學品本地化政策推進，公司積極參與台灣、
美國與中國多個新建廠案，並在高階氟素內襯產品市場形成與少
數日系廠商的寡佔格局。

二. 營運概況及展望 
產業概況 
氟素材料與設備產業屬於半導體與電子級化學品供應鏈中不可或
缺的基礎環節，其產品廣泛應用於高純化學品的儲存、輸送、製
程反應與廢液回收等系統，涵蓋化學儲槽、管線、內襯設備及運
輸槽車等。由於先進製程對化學品純度、製程穩定性與安全性的
要求日益嚴苛，氟素材料憑藉其優異的耐腐蝕性、化學惰性與低
金屬離子釋出特性，已成為電子級化學品系統的標準配置，對維
持半導體製程良率具有關鍵影響。近年來，隨著 3nm 、2nm 等先進
節點製程的推進，以及高純化學品用量的增加，氟素內襯與高潔
淨管路系統的市場需求持續成長，並高度仰賴具備客製化工程能
力與垂直整合生產的供應商。

起出現多個大型先進製程與記憶體廠新建案，華東與華北地區為

製程與封裝擴產計畫，化學品系統升級需求穩定。整體而言，該
產業具備技術門檻高、認證周期長、替代性低等特性，市場呈現
由少數具備高純材料加工與系統整合能力的國際廠商寡佔的格
局，且隨各地建廠高峰啟動，對領先供應商而言，成長機會正持
續擴大。

競爭優勢 
上品在全球氟素材料與內襯設備市場的競爭優勢，核心來自其完
整的垂直整合能力與跨區域佈局。公司能從氟素樹脂原料加工、
半成品製造，到內襯設備組裝一次到位，並具備客製化設計與現
場工程整合的能力，能因應不同化學品特性與製程需求，提供高
純度、耐腐蝕且符合嚴格製程規範的系統解決方案。與少數日系
同業相比，上品在台灣半導體供應鏈的在地化程度與反應速度具
優勢，並透過美國與中國的子公司直接切入當地市場，縮短專案
溝通與交付時程。由於高階氟素設備屬於認證周期長、替代性低
的利基市場，進入門檻高，使現有供應商的市場地位相對穩固，
上品憑藉多年的專案經驗與穩定品質，已在半導體與電子化學品
領域建立寡佔地位。

在競爭結構上，中國市場近年新增韓系與本土廠商參與，使價格
競爭壓力加劇，尤其在中階產品與部分專案上，上品需透過價格
策略、模組化產品及在地製造來維持市佔與毛利。美國市場雖競
爭者較少，但工程公司承包大包專案的模式，使供應商議價空間
受限，必須強化與終端客戶及系統整合商的關係。台灣則因先進
製程擴產持續，對高階內襯與 ISO Tank 等設備需求穩定，為上品
的核心利基市場。整體而言，上品的競爭策略在於強化三大區域
的市場滲透率、持續提升在地工程支援能力，並鎖定高附加價值
產品線，藉此在全球建廠潮與化學品供應鏈升級浪潮中鞏固並擴
大領先地位。

未來展望 
上品將持續聚焦於高階氟素內襯設備與高純化學品儲運系統的技
術深化，並以半導體與電子化學品產業為成長核心。公司將延續
中國市場大型專案的出貨動能，並加速推進北美區 ISO Tank 等高
附加價值產品線的導入，藉由產品標準化與模組化設計，縮短交
付週期、提升客戶轉換意願。面對中國中階產品市場價格競爭激
烈的挑戰，上品將強化嘉興基地的在地製造與採購能力，以降低
成本並縮短專案導入時間，同時透過技術升級與高潔淨等級的產
品差異化，維持在高階市場的毛利水準與市場地位。

長期而言，上品將善用全球建廠潮與化學品供應鏈升級的契機，
持續鞏固在台灣半導體先進製程市場的優勢，並深化與系統整合
商及終端客戶的協作，將業務版圖從設備供應擴展至整體工程解
決方案提供者。此外，公司將逐步布局氟素材料的上游原料與製
程優化，以提升關鍵材料自主性與供應穩定性，降低國際局勢及
匯率波動帶來的營運風險。

聯茂(6213) 
買進, TP 670 (潛在報酬 31.37%)

Target Price：670

展望後市， 聯茂受惠於一般型伺服器與 AI 伺服器需求持續升溫，
帶動 CCL 出貨動能強勁。為反映上游原物料（如 E-Glass 玻纖
布、高階銅箔） 嚴重供不應求與價格輪番上揚，公司啟動之漸進式
報價調漲將於下半年持續擴大發酵 ， 龐大的低基期槓桿效益將有效
推升產品平均售價 ， 並大幅修復中低階產品之毛利率 。隨一般伺服
器迎來 CPU 平台世代交替，將直接驅動材料由  M6 升級至 M7
（單價較 M6 顯著高出 30% 至 50%） ；加上低軌衛星（LEO）
地面接收站進入放量期，以及美系  AI GPU 廠高階專案預計於  
2027 年陸續放量，產品組合結構性優化將大幅推升營運規模與獲
利天花板。綜合以上，研究部預估聯茂  2026 年 EPS 為 18.74 
元；2027 年 EPS 為 44.80 元。考量公司長線受惠伺服器平台
規格升級、 新興應用放量與報價調漲紅利 ， 獲利成長趨勢明確且具
備爆發力； 加上目前評價面相較同業仍處於低位階 ， 研究部給予目
標價 670 元（15x 2027 EPS） ，投資建議為買進。  
⚫ 近期投資評等 公司基本資料 
聯茂電子（6213）成立於 1997 年，為全球主要的銅箔基板（CCL）與
黏合片 （Prepreg） 製造商之一。公司具備深厚的樹脂配方開發與壓合技
術，產品線涵蓋廣泛，能同時滿足成熟市場與高階應用的多元需求。在
營收方面，聯茂持續穩定供應消費性電子、車用及一般工業所需之常規
型基板（如傳統 FR4 及中低階耗損材料） ，維持龐大的基礎市佔率。另
一方面，為因應雲端運算與資料中心的高速傳輸需求，公 司近年積極將
產品重心向高頻高速 （Low Dk/Df） 材料推進 。 其自主研發的高階材料 （包
含 M6 至 M9 等級）已逐步擴大導入 AI 伺服器、高階運算（HPC）、
新一代交換器（3.2T）與低軌衛星（LEO）等前瞻應用領域，以滿足終
端硬體對於極低訊號損耗與高散熱的嚴苛標準。

在產能佈局上，聯茂透過台灣、中國及泰國等多地廠區進行彈性調度。
隨著終端客戶對 AI 伺服器與高階材料的規格升級（如 PCIe Gen6 ），
公司亦持續擴充泰國廠等海外高階產能，並積極推進石英布（ Q布） 、
PTFE 等次世代基板技術的研發與認證，以因應未來電子產業規格升級
的長期趨勢。

股票股利 0 漲價效益發酵與產品組合優化，第二季毛利率倍增、獲利大幅跳升 
聯茂近期公佈  2026 年第二季財報，合併營收為  115.30 億元，季增 
26.11%、年增 29.88%。營收擴張之主因，來自上游  E-Glass 玻纖布
與銅箔供應吃緊，公司於第二季落實報價調漲，單季累積漲幅達 30%。
此外，一般型伺服器需求維持穩健，佔營收比重約 55.5%，亦為整體出
貨規模提供基本盤支撐。

獲利結構方面，第二季毛利率由首季的 11.42% 回升至 22.02%，營業
利益率亦提 升至  16.03% ，單季營業利益達  18.48 億 元 ， 季 增 
335.67%、年增 134.51%。毛利率與營利率顯著擴張，主要受惠於單季 
30% 的報價漲幅大幅改善佔營收大宗（M4 以下佔約 70%）之中低階
產品利差，搭配營收規模放大稀釋固定折舊費用，進而推升本業獲利。

業外及稅率方面，第二季淨營業外支出為 1,427 萬元，主要為認列出售
中國小型壓合 PCB 廠之處分損失；單季有效稅率則因中國廠盈餘匯回
以支應無錫新廠擴建，上升至 30.2%。綜合以上，第二季歸屬於母公司
業主稅後淨利達  12.79 億元，季增 306.76%、年增 204.29%，單季 
EPS 達 3.52 元。

七、八月營收連創新高，漲價效益與伺服器需求推升第三季營運 
聯茂 8 月營收達 50.44 億元，月增 6.21%、年增 97.93%，連續兩個
月改寫單月營收新高 ； 累計前八月營收達 304.66 億元 ， 年增 42.25%。
展望第三季，受惠於上游玻纖布（E-Glass）與銅箔供應持續緊缺，公司
順利向客戶轉嫁成本，帶動第三季報價持續調漲 （預估單季漲幅達 15% 
至 20% ） ；此外，一般型伺服器終端需求維持強勁，且公司於美系主力 
CPU 平台供應鏈中維持高市佔率 ， 出貨動能無虞 ， 推升整體營收維持強
勁季增軌道。

獲利方面，第三季雖將認列員工分紅與認股獎金，預期將墊高單季營業
費用，然受惠於報價調漲之槓桿效益持續發酵，然受惠於報價持續 調漲
帶動營收規模顯著放大，將有效稀釋營業費用率，抵銷費用端之負擔。
此外，缺料狀況微幅改善帶動稼動率穩步回升，且漲價效益持續修復佔
營收大宗之中低階產品（M4 以下）利差，預期第三季毛利率將自前季
之 22.02% 顯著擴張至 27.50%，本業獲利結構保持強勁。

綜合以上 ， 研究部預估聯茂第三季營收為 150.76 億元 ， 季增 30.75%、
年增 95.17%；毛利率預估為 27.50%，較前季持續呈現顯著擴張；歸

屬母公司稅後淨利為  21.75 億元，季增  70.04%、年增 570%，單季 
EPS 預估為 5.98 元。

報價調漲效益與高階材料滲透率拉升，推升 2026 與 2027 營運規模 
展望後市，在伺服器基礎建設方面，受惠於一般型伺服器 CPU 平台世
代交替，雖受限於 IC 測試進度而遞延至今年底或明年初放量，然終端
需求維持強勁，且聯茂於美系主力 CPU 平台 （AMD）之 ODM 供應鏈
中掌握高達 70% 之市佔率，出貨動能無虞。此平台轉換將直接驅動材
料由 M6 升級至 M7， 考量 M7 產品單價 （ASP）較 M6 顯著高出 30% 
至 50%，此規格轉換將大幅挹注營收規模，帶動 M6 以上高階產品佔
比於 2027 年進一步攀升至 35% 至 40%。 此外 ， 針對次世代 AI 伺服
器 ， 公司已全面將資源集中於 M9 等級材料 ， 其產品已於 2025 年底順
利通過美系 GPU 大廠認證；考量 M9 毛利率高達 50% 以上，預期於 
2027 年第二季起隨終端客戶放量 ， 僅需達成低個位數之營收滲透率 ， 即
可對整體毛利帶來顯著拉抬效果。

除伺服器應用外，低軌衛星（LEO）亦為 2027 年另一成長動能。聯茂
已於今年下半年順利通過美系指標客戶 （SpaceX）認證，預期相關專案
將於 2027 年上半年陸續發酵。初期將以衛星地面接收站之材料需求
（M4、M6 等級為主）先行放量，後續將進一步延伸至天上衛星所需之
極低損耗高階材料（M7、M8） ，為明年增添穩健之獲利支柱。

針對原物料供需與報價走勢，因 E-Glass 玻纖布極度短缺，且高階銅箔
產能排擠效應顯現，預期供不應求態勢將延續至 2027 年中旬。為反映
成本，公司下半年持續落實報價調漲，第三、第四季每季皆維持約 15% 
- 20% 之漲幅，並將於 2027 年上半年維持微幅上調趨勢。在稼動率部
分，隨中國玻纖布供應商產能於年底微幅釋出，預估第四季產能利用率
可望由 70% 至 75% 回升至 78% 左右 ， 並於明年下半年逐步朝 85% 
邁進。。

產能擴充與長線資本支出方面，考量前段關鍵設備（上膠機）交期長達 
1.5 至 2 年，公司採取集中於下半年開出之穩健擴產節奏。2026 年底
總產能將達 570 萬張/月；2027 年底將於無錫廠擴增 60 萬張 ， 達 630 
萬張/月；2028 年配合美系 ASIC 客戶長線專案放量，無錫廠與泰國廠
將分別再開出 135 萬張與 60 萬張 ， 年底總產能將達 825 萬張/月 ， 為
長線高階板材需求奠定產能基礎。

結合以上，研究部預估聯茂  2026 年全年營收為  534.02 億元，年增 
61.34%，毛利率達 24.39%，歸屬母公司稅後淨利為  68.12 億元，年
增 351.03%， 全年 EPS 為 18.74 元；2027 年隨一般型伺服器 M7 滲
透率翻倍、AI 伺服器 M9 材料實質放量，加上低軌衛星專案啟動，全
年 營收 預估達  838.22 億元， 年增 56.96%，毛 利率 進一步 攀升至  
31.77%，歸屬母公司稅後淨利達  162.87 億元，年增 139.11%，全年 
EPS 預估為 44.80 元。

結論與建議 : 
展望後市，聯茂受惠於一般型伺服器與 AI 伺服器需求持續升溫，帶動 
CCL 出貨動能強勁。為反映上游原物料（如 E-Glass 玻纖布、高階銅
箔）嚴重供不應求與價格輪番上揚，公司啟動之漸進式報價調漲將於下
半年持續擴大發酵，龐大的低基期槓桿效益將有效推升產品平均售價，
並大幅修復中低階產品之毛利率。隨一般伺服器迎來 CPU 平台世代交
替 ， 將直接驅動材料由 M6 升級至 M7（單價較 M6 顯著高出 30% 至 
50%） ； 加上低軌衛星 （LEO） 地面接收站進入放量期 ， 以及美系 AI GPU 
廠高階專案預計於 2027 年陸續放量，產品組合結構性優化將大幅推升
營運規模與獲利天花板。綜合以上，研究部預估聯茂 2026 年 EPS 為 
18.74 元；2027 年 EPS 為 44.80 元。考量公司長線受惠伺服器平台
規格升級、新興應用放量與報價調漲紅利，獲利成長趨勢明確且具備爆
發力；加上目前評價面相較同業仍處於低位階，研究部給予目標價 670 
元（15x 2027 EPS） ，投資建議為買進。

胡連 (6279 TT) 
非中國地區營收增長可期

永豐觀點 
看好胡連憑藉非中國地區訂單占比提升與歐洲併購案潛在綜效 ， 中長期出貨結構將
更趨多元化。 
 投資評價與建議 
維持買進投資建議： 預估 2026、2027 年營收 112、125.8 億元 (+14%、
+25.8%YoY)，毛利率 28.53% 、30.05% ，營業利益 15.3、20 億元 (-7%、
+30.6%YoY)，稅後淨利 12.75、16.3 億元(+1.33%、+28.1%YoY)，完全稀釋後
稅後 EPS 10.46、13.40 元。考量胡連 3Q26 原物料成本壓力延續、毛利率預期低
於 30%，加上歐洲併購案交割時程與合併後費用率仍有不確定性，評價上採較保
守之本益比假設。以 2027 年 EPS 13.40 元進行評價，本益比由 11X 下修至 10X，
目標價調整至 134 元(10X*2027EPS 13.40 元)。 惟現階段股價評價仍屬相對低檔 ，
隨非中國地區占比提升與歐洲併購綜效逐步顯現， 中長期配置價值仍在， 建議可逢
低佈局，故維持買進建議。

### Page 2

2

胡連為台灣端子大廠：胡連精密股份有限公司成立於 1977 年，為台灣車用連接器
製造商，主要生產汽車端子、塑膠盒及模具等產品為主， 2Q26 產品組合為塑件
35.4%、端子 28.4%、電源配線盒(保險絲盒) 11.6%、線束 10.7%、板端件 6.1%、
高頻 5.1%、 高壓0.7%等 。 商業模式為將原物料(塑膠 、 銅等)製成端子或連接器後 ，
供貨給下游線束或模組廠，再透過線束或模組廠交貨給汽車廠商。2Q26 地區域銷
售比重：中國76%、台灣 4.7%、越南 2.7%、印尼 2.3%、歐洲 3.3%、美洲 5.1%、
亞太 5.8%。中國客戶多為 OEM 車廠，主要為中國自有品牌車廠，2Q26 比重為
吉利 11.3%、比亞迪 7.9%、長安 4.6%、Lear 3.9%、奇瑞 3%、五菱 1.1%。 
即將迎來中國市場旺季 ； 中期中國自主品牌重心轉向海外 ， 胡連藉多地產能卡位在
地化供應：7-8 月中國內需車市銷量偏弱，但受惠出口市場表現相對支撐，且胡連
主要客戶表現優於產業平均，推升胡連 7-8 月營收年增逾三成，預估 9-10 月營收
逐月成長，惟 4Q26 受基期墊高影響，年增率預期收斂至個位數。 
在中國內需疲軟的背景下， 中國自主品牌車廠未來重心逐步轉向海外， 包含海外當
地設廠 ， 胡連有望透過越南 、 印尼等既有產能 ， 甚至歐洲新併購機會取得海外產能 ，
提供在地化供應服務， 快速反應當地需求， 此為胡連中長期評價重新評估非中國地
區貢獻度的重要觀察指標。 
非中國地區(東南亞 、 歐洲等)訂單加速放量 、 歐洲新併購機會 ， 多元廠區分散風險 ：
(1) 胡連為比亞迪東南亞擴張戰略下的核心在地受惠者，在印尼取得比亞迪五款車
型的 PCB 保險絲盒訂單，隨比亞迪印尼廠產能爬坡，胡連營收認列高峰預計集中
於 2027~2028 年。(2) 因應客戶分散地緣風險需求，胡連於 2027 年擴大越南供
貨連接器產品予美系電動車客戶 ， 成長幅度上看50%以上 。(3) 歐洲現有客戶以比
雅久及 Stellantis 成長較顯著，未來加入新併購公司之業務，有望拓展更多客戶及
產品。(4) BMW 亞洲區原無連接器供應商(原由 TE 供貨)，今年胡連已切入一個新
料號，具備後續放量空間。綜合以上，預期 2027 年非中國地區占比將由 2026 年
約 20%提升至 25~30%(中國占比則由 80%降至 70~75%)。 
歐洲併購案為切入法拉利供應鏈的關鍵一步 ：胡連正評估收購兩家義大利公司， 其
一為高階車廠線束前端設計合格供應商， 具快速打樣能力； 胡連本身具連接器與線
束產能，可與其形成「連接器＋線束」 綜效供應，協助其在法拉利等高階車廠之滲
透率提升。其二聚焦農耕機特用市場，仍在價格議定階段，進度較慢。超跑相關標
的預計 10 月完成交割，2027 年可望完整貢獻全年營收；今明兩年財測目前均未
納入併購貢獻，故後續營收有上修空間；另外，合併後整體營業費用率預期將微幅
上升，因歐洲公司費用結構高於胡連本身水準。 
原物料成本壓力延續至 3Q26，毛利率預期低於 30%；展望 2027 年切入更多模
組化、智能化產品供應，胡連高附加價值產品比重持續提升：3Q26 銅價大漲，使
得實際銅成本季增 3%； 塑料成本也持續增長 ， 目前價格已較開戰前水準高約5%，
故預期 3Q26 將受原物料價格影響較大，毛利率將與 2Q26 相當；展望 4Q26 伴
隨營收規模放大，毛利率有機會重新靠近 30%。 
研究處估算 2026 年胡連新產品，如高頻、高壓、保險絲盒等將貢獻9~10 億元(原
預估 7~8 億元)， 隨著新產品陸續放量 ， 明後年量會最大 ， 新產品毛利率會比較高 ，
且胡連一直積極從一般低壓線束、連接器，轉向區域化、模組化的電線管理產品發
展，預計將先切入特殊車輛之車燈域控制、座椅域控制器等，隨著總成件產品比重
增加，也有助於均價及利潤率之提升，有望逐步淡化原物料上漲對毛利帶來的影
響。

營運現況與分析

### Page 3

3

維持買進建議，目標價調整至 134 元：看好胡連在中國市場基本盤維持穩健成長
之餘，非中國地區(東南亞、歐洲)訂單占比加速提升，且積極從一般低壓連接器轉
向區域化、模組化產品，有助於產品組合優化；另外，歐洲併購案有望切入法拉利
等高階超跑供應鏈，長線出貨結構更趨多元化，降低對單一市場之依賴。 
考量胡連 3Q26 原物料成本壓力延續、毛利率預期低於 30%，加上歐洲併購案交
割時程與合併後費用率仍有不確定性，評價上採較保守之本益比假設，以2027 年
EPS 13.40 元進行評價，本益比由 11X 下修至 10X，目標價調整至 134 元
(10X*2027EPS 13.40 元)。惟現階段股價評價仍屬相對低檔，隨非中國地區占比提
升與歐洲併購綜效逐步顯現，中長期配置價值仍在，建議可逢低佈局，故維持買進
建議。

營收走勢圖

研究員/周品三 DUKE.ZHOU@uni-psg.com

日本與歐洲市場的矽水膠及高階光學需求 ， 將是晶碩營收成長的重
要來源；大溪與南通產線效率改善，加上越南廠預計 2H27 開始貢
獻，可望增加訂單承接彈性。矽水膠營收占比目標將由 2026 年的
10%提升至 2027 年的 15，亦有利於提高產品平均售價。研究部預
估2026/2027 年營收86.17 億元/105.61 億元 ，+22.4%YoY/22%YoY、
毛利率 53.2%/53.9% 、稅後 EPS 27.21/33 元，
+30.3%YoY/+21.3%YoY。評價上，考量日歐客戶需求、高階產品滲
透率提升及海外產能布局 ， 中長期營運成長具支撐 ； 惟新產能效益
仍取決於認證 、 量產與稼動進度 ， 對毛利率及費用控制的實際影響
亦須持續追蹤，故以 2027 年 EPS 33 元計算，給予評價中緣 14 倍
本益比，目標價 462 元，潛在漲幅 21.8%，維持買進建議。

重點摘要： 
1. 1H26賺13.13元，符合預期，2H26維持成長態勢： 
晶碩1H26營收40.00億元，+24.2%YoY；營業毛利21.26億元，
+24.6%YoY，毛利率53.1%，稅後淨利10.27億元，+26.2%YoY，
EPS 13.13元，+27.6%YoY。由於營業費用僅+11.4%YoY，低於
營收增幅，營業利益率由約25.2%提升至28.2%。單季來看，
2Q26營收21.15億元，+12.1%QoQ，毛利率53.0%，主要受到戰
爭推升PP原料價格影響 ； 費用率則因人力成本增加及約1,250
萬元一次性庫藏股相關費用升至25.3%，稅後EPS 7.08元。展
望2H26，預期營收將逐季成長，3Q26已為雙11與4Q26需求備
貨 ； 目前PP價格已有回落 ， 惟3Q26夏季電費估對毛利率造成約
1個百分點壓力，4Q26隨電費恢復正常及產品組合改善，毛利
率可望回升 。 整體而言 ， 營收動能仍具支撐 ， 研究部預估2026
年營收86.17億元 ，+22.4%YoY， 毛利率53.2%， 稅後EPS 27.21
元，+30.3%YoY。

2. 日本與歐洲為成長主軸，矽水膠與高階光學提升產品價值： 
以1H26主要市場營收占比觀察，日本約60%～65%、中國約10%
～15%、台灣13.62%、歐洲7.50%。其中日本仍為最大市場， 受
惠矽水膠日拋 、 彩片 、 多焦及散光等高階光學需求 ，2Q26開始
出貨多焦彩片， 帶動市場維持雙位數成長； 歐洲則以矽水膠 、
散光及三合一產品為主要動能，預期2027年將與日本並列主
要成長區域 ； 中國市場逐步回穩 ， 雖營收占比未明顯提高 ， 絕
對金額仍增加，公司採取維持低階產品市占、加強高階特殊
彩片的策略；台灣市場維持約5%成長，受惠自有品牌矽水膠

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要批露及免責聲明  2

新品與代工需求增加 。 產品別占比而言 ，1H26矽水膠營收占比
約7%～8%，2026年全年目標10%，2027年目標進一步提高至
15%；高階光學產品1H26營收占比已超過10%。ASP方面，若將
一般水膠產品售價設為 1，高階光學約為 1.25、矽水膠約為
1.5，產品組合升級有助於改善平均銷售單價，使營收成長同
時受惠於出貨量與產品價值提升。高階光學產品規格較多，
散光產品約108個SKU， 高於一般球面的36個 ， 公司透過集中排
產降低換線頻率，以兼顧產品多樣性與生產效率。研究部認
為，後續成長重點除出貨量擴大，更在於材料升級與複合功
能產品的價值提升。

3. 大溪廠持續擴充，越南廠預計2H27開始貢獻： 
目前整體稼動率超過80%，因此持續擴產以因應訂單需求。龜
山廠月產能維持9,000萬片 ； 大溪廠目前月產能1,500萬片 ， 預
計2026年底增至2,000萬片；南通廠1H26已新增產能，目前月
產能約800萬片。海外新據點越南廠初期規劃月產能 1,000萬
片 ， 目前正進行設備確效與產品取證 ， 預計2026年底完成 ， 並
於2H27開始貢獻營收 ， 初期優先供應中國市場水膠產品 ， 同時
推進其他產品認證 。 現有月產能加總約1.13億片 ； 若大溪擴充
與越南初期產能全數到位，且其他廠區產能不變，月產能可
達約1.28億片，較目前增加約13.3%。生產技術方面，公司軟
硬體設備均為自行設計，新產線建置僅需3個月，降低對外部
設備交期的依賴；新產線通常需1～2個月磨合，涵蓋人員訓
練與系統串聯。因具備水膠、矽水膠與高階光學產品共線生
產能力，透過製程參數調整彈性切換，有利於隨訂單結構調
配產能。

4. 穩步擴產，產品組合持續轉佳，維持買進： 
展望2027年 ， 日本與歐洲市場的矽水膠及高階光學需求 ， 將是
晶碩營收成長的重要來源；大溪與南通產線效率改善，加上
越南廠預計2H27開始貢獻 ， 可望增加訂單承接彈性 。 矽水膠營
收占比目標由2026年的10%提升至2027年的15%，亦有利於提
高 產 品 平 均 售 價 。 研 究 部 預 估2027 年 營 收105.61 億 元 ，
+22.6%YoY、毛利率53.9%、稅後EPS 33元，+21.3%YoY。評價
上，考量日歐客戶需求、高階產品滲透率提升及海外產能布
局 ， 中長期營運成長具支撐 ； 惟新產能效益仍取決於認證 、 量
產與稼動進度，對毛利率及費用控制的實際影響亦須持續追
蹤 ， 故以2027年EPS 33元計算， 給予評價中緣14倍本益比，目
標價462元，潛在漲幅21.8%，維持買進建議。

3Q26 GPU/ASIC 測試板如預期出貨，EPS 預計季增 11% 
預估 3Q26 營收季增 18%，主因 AI GPU 後段測試板及 ASIC 前段測試板進
入放量期。毛利率季減 2.6ppts 至 54.9%，主因新產品預燒測試板/SLT 測試
板將逐漸提高營收貢獻。EPS 季增 11.3%/年增 98.9%達 17 元。4Q26 營收
則受惠公司 8M26 第二波的產能擴張將開始用於出貨予預燒爐客戶，同時
TPU 新產品亦將進入量產期，預計營收季增 12%。毛利率年減 2.0 個百分
點至 54.0%，主因新產品預燒測試板 /SLT 測試板將逐漸提高營收貢獻使整
體產品組合轉差。然在營運規模擴大，預計 EPS 仍將季增 13%達 18.9 元。 
EV AI 探針卡通過驗證，產能提升下有望切入其餘專案 
目前公司已通過 EV AI 探針卡客戶驗證，預計在 1H27 將開始出貨量產探針
卡予客戶。此案件將採雙晶片(dual-die)的探針卡設計架構，單張探針卡針數
將超過 40000 針且預計在 2027 年將出貨超過 100 張探針卡。此外公司將利
用自製植針機及探針的優勢，將現有每月 7-80 萬 MEMS 探針產能於 2Q27
擴充至每月 120-130 萬根針，並切入該客戶採相似設計的其餘 AI CPU 探針
卡案件。目前該客戶 CPU 案件仍在工程驗證階段，預計於 4Q26-1Q27 tape 
out，CPU 探針卡量產營收貢獻則主要將落在 2H27。預計 2027 年受惠兩大
案件貢獻下，公司 HPC 探針卡營收將年增 282%，營收佔比由 8%提升到
17%。 
探針產能擴充及通過驗證有助於切入其餘案件並帶動評價提升
預計公司在 2027 年將出貨約 100 張 EV AI 探針卡，佔營收約 8%，成為公
司最大的單一探針卡專案。在公司預計將 MEMS 探針產能擴充 67%且雙晶
片探針卡技術已通過客戶認證之下，預計公司將有更多機會切入該客戶 採相
似設計其餘 AI CPU 探針卡案件。在探針卡有望切入客戶其餘 AI CPU 探針
卡案件且 HPC 測試板業務成長趨勢不變下，基於切入 AI 供應鏈後約 1x 標
準差的本益比 35x 與 2027F EPS NT$120 ，給予目標價 4250 元的買進評等。

EV AI 探針卡通過客戶驗證，在產能提升下有望切入同一客戶其餘專案 
目前公司已通過 EV AI 探針卡客戶驗證，預計在 1H27 將開始出貨量產探針卡予客戶。此案件將採
雙晶片的探針卡設計架構，單張探針卡針數將超過 40000 針且預計在 2027 年將出貨約 100 張探針
卡，佔營收約 8%，成為公司最大的單一探針卡專案。市場上多項 AI 相關 GPU/CPU/ASIC 專案交
錯推進需求快速成長且產品推出時程持續壓縮下，在供給成長速度仍受植針效率受限的情況下，更
多 AI 周邊晶片的客戶開始脫離既有供應商體係，尋求多家供應商負責同一專案以確保晶片能在客
戶指定時程內交付。精測在過往在 MEMS 探針擴產策略上較為保守，主因手機市場市佔率變動較
大。然在 EV AI 大案件確認將進入量產階段，預計公司將能利用自製植針機以及探針的優勢，將現
有每月 7-80 萬 MEMS 探針產能於 2Q27 擴充至每月 120-130 萬根針。在產能大幅擴充且雙晶片探
針卡技術已通過客戶認證之下，預計公司亦有機會切入該客戶採相似設計的其餘 AI CPU 探針卡案
件成為供應商之一。目前該客戶 CPU 案件仍在工程驗證階段，預計於 4Q26-1Q27 tape out ，CPU
探針卡量產營收貢獻則主要將落在 2H27。預計 2027 年受惠 EV AI 探針卡大案件進入量產出貨以
及 AI CPU 在 2H27 進入初期拉貨下，預計公司 HPC 探針卡營收將年增 282%，營收佔比由 8%提
升到 17%。 
此外，目前觀察到預燒爐客戶在美國 的產能爬坡進展順利，且除了既有 TPU 客戶外亦成功切入
GPU 客戶之下，預期 2027 年公司預燒爐測試板以及系統板相關營收將優於先前預期達到公司整體
營收 20%。同時，在公司持續轉嫁成本上漲以及高毛利 FT/CP 產品單價隨主要客戶下一代晶片規
格一同成長帶動之下，預期 2027 年毛利率將能維持在 55%，達公司指引區間的上緣，並帶動獲利
率年增 4 個百分點至 37.5，EPS 年增 95%至 120 元。

產業概況  
探針卡產值將以 CAGR 12%成長至 2027 年 
晶圓測試(CP)的主要目的是為了在將晶圓切割成晶片並進入封裝流程前，檢測其上是否存在瑕疵，
以節省封裝有瑕疵裸晶造成的多餘成本，同時監控製造良率。 CP 測試項目通常包含直流電 (DC)測
試，該測試會評估半導體設備的基本電性，如電壓、電流和電阻。晶圓測試 (CP)的測試介面採用探
針卡，本中心預估 2024-2027 年探針卡產值將以 CAGR 12%成長。 
圖 5：半導體測試流程主要分為前段(CP)及後段(FT)

資料來源：公司資料、元大投顧預估 
此外，晶片在封裝後需要再經過後段測試(FT)，而有些高功率晶片還會經過老化測試(Burn-in Test) 。
近期，本中心觀察到旗艦 AP 及 AI GPU 已開始引進系統級測試(SLT)。隨著測試時間增加，本中心
預估測試座(Test Socket) 產值年複合成長率將達 10%，優於老化測試座之 5%，而整體測試座產值
將以 CAGR 8%成長至 2026 年。

目前公司已通過 EV AI 探針卡客戶驗證，預計在 1H27 將開始出貨量產探針卡予客戶。此案件預計

公司簡介  
精測成立於 2005 年，總部及生產工廠皆位於桃園平鎮，前身為中華電信研究所內部之高速 PCB 團隊。主要生產測試探針、
晶圓測試板、IC 測試板並提供測試服務。其客戶涵蓋高通、聯發科、AMD、Nvidia 等國際知名 IC 設計業者。公司為全球
少數兼具研發及製造晶圓級測試探針的半導體測試介面廠，除了自行開發探針生產設備，也掌握探針材料、藥水與金屬合
成的關鍵技術。

ESG 分析  
分別藉由「在 ESG 議題上的曝險」和「個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力」兩個面向來衡量公司於 ESG 上的表現。 
► ESG 總分： 中華精測整體的 ESG 風險評級屬於中等風險，於 Sustainalytics 資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排名亦排行於中間
水平的位置，亦在電子零組件行業的公司中排名略微領先同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 中華精測的整體曝險屬於中等水準，與電子零組件行業的平均水準相當。公司較需要改善的  
ESG 議題包含資源使用、溫室氣體以外之排放、商業道德等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：中華精測在針對重大 ESG 議題的管理水準和執行力屬中等。公司對於投資者與大眾
的資訊揭露能力弱，在關鍵領域缺乏政策與計畫，不過目前該公司並未涉及任何與 ESG 相關的重大爭議。

投資評等說明 
買進：根據本中心對該檔個股投資期間絕對或相對報酬率之預測，我們對該股持正面觀點。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股之發展前景、財務表現、利多題
材、評價資訊以及風險概況之分析。建議投資人於投資部位中增持該股。 
持有-超越同業：本中心認為根據目前股價，該檔個股基本面吸引力高於 同業。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股發展前景、財務表現、利多題材、評價資訊
以及風險概況之分析。 
持有-落後同業：本中心認為根據目前股價，該檔個股基本面吸引力低於 同業。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股發展前景、財務表現、利多題材、評價資訊
以及風險概況之分析。 
賣出：根據本中心對該檔個股投資期間絕對或相對報酬率之預測，我們對該股持負面觀點。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股之發展前景、財務表現、利多題
材、評價資訊以及風險概況之分析。建議投資人於投資部位中減持該股。 
評估中：本中心之預估、評等、目標價尚在評估中，但仍積極追蹤該個股。 
限制評等：為遵循相關法令規章及/或元大之政策，暫不給予評等及目標價。

註：元大給予個股之目標價係依 12 個月投資期間計算。大中華探索系列報告並無正式之 12 個月目標價，其投資建議乃根據分析師報告中之指定期間分析
而得。

研究員/蔡佾璋 EASONTSAI@uni-psg.com

研究部維持中傑 -KY(6965)投資評等為中立，主要考量： (1)中傑雖
2Q26 營運轉盈，單季稅後純益4,651 萬元，QoQ 虧轉盈，-77.5%YoY，
稅後 EPS 0.3 元，仍低於研究部預估的0.74 元，1H26 仍虧損 5417 萬
元，稅後EPS-0.34 元。 (2)目前全球大環境消費景氣持續疲弱、不確
定性高，歐美客戶下單態度謹慎保守，且 2H26 仍處策略調整階段，產
能利用率預期較 2Q26 下降，因此公司表示對 2026 及 2027 年營收保
守看待。(3)雖公司現已著手提升高毛利訂單比重，但仍在調整期，效
益尚未充分顯現，短期毛利率改善幅度有限。(4)印尼新廠於 2027 年
初開始投產，初期有產能爬坡及學習曲線，折舊固定成本比重較高 ，
因此對毛利率仍保守看待。研究部認為公司短期要回到營運狀較佳的
15%以上毛利率之機率較低，預估中傑-KY 2026 年、2027 年稅後 EPS 
2.06 元(原估 3.19 元)、4.83 元，分別為-40%YoY、+134.4%，過往評
價區間為 10-25 倍，目前本益比約 14 倍，評價合理，故維持中立評
等，目標價 72 元(15xPER *2027EPS)。

中傑-KY成立於1983年，發跡於台中大雅，以皮鞋起家，目前
主要業務是鞋類產品生產 、 代工 ， 以運動鞋 、 休閒鞋和皮鞋為
大宗。台灣為營運與接單總部，中國、越南與印尼廠區均為
100%全資持股，印度廠則採51%持股之合資模式營運。公司的
8個生產基地主要分佈在中國、越南、印度，2025年總產量為
3,233萬雙 ，-20.2%YoY，2025年總產能約為4,122萬雙/年，推
算稼動率約78%，目前員工人數約為 2.8萬人(6月底為3.2萬
人)。 出貨雙數方面，2Q26出貨量810.3萬雙，+3.1%YoY， 相較
1Q26的-19.7%YoY有明顯好轉， 1H26累積出貨量為 1524.4萬
雙，-9%YoY，仍呈現衰退。

2. 預估3Q26稅後EPS 1.4元，+293%YoY 
2Q26營收56.6億元，+18.3%QoQ，+8.4%YoY，營收成長主要因
出貨雙數提升。公司著手提升高毛利訂單比重，因此毛利率
12.7%(原估10.6%)，+2.7pctQoQ，+1.1pctYoY，優於預期， 然
費用率與稅率也同步提高，故 稅後純益4,651萬元，QoQ虧轉
盈，-77.5%YoY，稅後EPS 0.3元，低於研究部預估的0.74元。

展望3Q26，中傑7+8月合計營收37.6億元，+2.9%YoY，營收達
成率68.3%，符合預期，因消費景氣持續疲弱，品牌客戶下單
謹慎且以急單為主 ， 訂單能見度有限 ， 對2H26訂單與營收展望
保守看待。故研究部預估3Q26營收55億元(原估61.8億元)，-
2.9%QoQ，+2%YoY， 毛利率僅較2Q26略增至13.6%(原估13.3%)，
營業利益2.8億元，+81.8%QoQ，+614.3%YoY，稅後EPS 1.4元
(原估1.61元)，+372%QoQ，+293%YoY。

附錄 一 ： 評 等 之 標 準 
評等  定義  
強力買進     預估未來 6 個月內的絕對報酬超過 25%以上  
買進  預估未來 6 個月內的絕對報酬 10% 以上  
中立  預估未來 6 個月內的絕對報酬介於 10～-10%  
降低持股  預估未來 6 個月內的絕對報酬介於 (-10%)以下

iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Wait-Time Lukewarm

Maintained  Hold  
 Target price $369

iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max wait -time lukewarm: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre -
orders began on Sept 12 in the U.S. and many other countries. Generally speaking, the wati-
time appears lukewarm, with: 1) 3–4 weeks for 256GB/512GB Pro Max across all colors, as 
well as Burgundy 1TB in the U.S.；2) 2–3 weeks for Glacier 256GB/512GB Pro Max in China; 
3) 1–2 weeks for Black/Glacier 1TB Pro Max in the U.S. ；4) immediate availability for Silver 
1TB and most 2TB Pro Max models in the U.S, as well as most iPhone 18 Pro configurations 
except for Burgundy 256GB in the U.S . We attribute the lukewarm wait -time to limited spec 
upgrade, higher pricing (especially for large storage models), etc. We also expect the Pro Max 
to be impacted by iPhone Duo and the criticism of heavy weight.  
iPhone Duo feedback generally positive, yet we lower the  build plan: The iPhone Duo, 
priced at $1,999 in the U.S., opened pre ‑orders on Oct 16 and officially launched on Oct 23. 
Early reviews were positive, highlighting its polished folding experience, high ‑quality inner 
display, and improved multitasking in iO S 27, but also point to trade ‑offs including a heavier 
and thicker form factor, a visible crease, and a dual‑camera. Due to hinge constraints, we are 
reducing the iPhone Duo EMS build plan from 7m to 6m units in 2026. We also lower the 
iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Ma x build plan to 72m units given the constraints associated with the 
adjustable‑aperture camera. 
Maintain Hold: Driven by investors’ appetite being away from AI capex themes, Apple share 
price outperformed Nasdaq by 12% since July. Fundamentally, market’s worry about memory 
cost is being eased but should persist, in our view. We estimate the DRAM/NAND cost to be 
up from $0.37 per Gb/$0.09 per GB in iPhone 17 (initial launch) to $1.5 per Gb/$0.25 per GB 
in iPhone 18 Pro, suggesting likely cost pressure on current pricing. Valuation wise, the share 
price trades at 32x FY27E P/E with 20% earnings CAGR, suggesting the stock isn ’t cheap. 
We maintain earnings estimates and TP of $369, based on 35x FY27E.  
Risks: 1) weak demand, 2) competition, 3) product delays, 4) geo-tension.

Valuation and Recommendation  
Hold with TP of $369 
We rate Apple (AAPL US) Hold and set our TP at $369 which is based on 35x our FY27E EPS estimate. 
We believe it is important to capture the 2H26 -3Q27’s iPhone 18 product cycle, given high market 
interest. We adopt P/E methodology as we believe the market now mainly focuses on the company’s 
earnings outlook, and we usually apply P/E method to downstream firms.  
We believe Apple’s ecosystem will remain strong and associated revenue durability is high. This is 
backed by Apple's installed base growth, double digit YoY growth in services. However, the market 
would wait for visibility for its Apple Intelligence. Meanwhile, the market will need more visibility on the 
higher-high retail prices for the iPhone 18 series due to the rising cost over tariff and 2nm/memories. 
That said, we expect its earnings growth to be high-teens to 20% YoY in FY26E-FY28E, from single 
digit YoY in FY22-FY24. Considering >30x one-year P/E, the stock doesn’t look particularly cheap.

### Page 1

Mid-Qtr Update on Yield Expansion, Foundry Wins

Maintained  Buy  
 Target price $150

Raise TP to $150: Intel share price has underperformed since July, due to new share 
offerings (which we view as long -term constructive) and concerns over PC cuts at TSMC 
which were misleading. Based on our supply chain research, we believe its yields for server 
CPU (18A) and EMIB substrate were better than expected. That said, it is on track to expand 
the Foundry client base which will be from existing top-tier U.S. fabless to Terafab cooperation 
and HBM base die, which is likely in 2029 for 2 major ones. Meanwhile, CPU tailwinds, 
strengthened by GPT-6, continue. We fine  tune our EPS estimates by + 2%/+0% in 
2026E/2027E and lift TP from $136 to $150, now based on SOTP.  
CPU tailwinds on GPT-6, NVDA cooperation for head-node: We expect compute demand 
to continue scaling, with GPT-6’s agentic capabilities, which extends from coding to broader 
knowledge work such as financial modeling and scientific workflows, benefiting CPU demand. 
We reiterate our view that the global server CPU TAM to reach $211bn by 2030. For Intel, we 
believe its CWF will start in small volume in late -2026 with full production in 1Q27, yet, the 
major volume will be Diamond Rapids, supported by stronger SRAM/LPDDR5X and number 
of cores, likely in mid-2027. For NVDA, we still expect a potential cooperation in PC and now 
expect a likely x86 CPU adoption for head-node as a variant of Rosa Feynman platform.  
Foundry yields & projects: 1) Yields: Following our earlier view of  18A yields of ~80% in 
2Q26 for Pather Lake, we believe the larger sized server CPU, CWF, has been improved to 
~50% yields, vs. ~20% in June ; 2) Capacity: we reiterate our report of Big Lift on Foundry 
Capacity on June 8 of 40/60/80KPM and 0/6/24KPM for 18A/14A by end-2026/2027/2028. 3) 
Projects: Following our report of More Than Just Apple on Dec 1 (highlighted Apple, Nvidia, 
etc), we believe it is working on the Terafab project, likely providing lP licensing, factory build-
up, etc. 4) HBM base die: We expect it to be in 2029, likely for 2 major HBM suppliers. 
EMIB & substrate yields tracking ahead : We believe the market concerns over EMIB 
substrate yields  were based on outdated datapoints , while our supply chain research 
suggests development continues to advance, with tw o Japanese suppliers improving yields 
from 20–25% on initial testing vehicles to ~45% on the testing vehicles in Aug. This is on track 
to reach the following yield target of >50% in certified testing vehicles and ~55% in Jan. We 
reiterate our robust customer pipeline on $1.1bn/$7bn backend revenue in 2027E/2028E.  
Risks: 1) AI slowdown; 2) new product/node delay; 3) yield rates; 4) competition.

Valuation and Recommendation  
Maintain Buy with TP of $150 
We rate Intel (INT C US) Buy and set our TP at $ 150, which is based on : 1) 3. 5x our 202 8E BVPS 
estimate for Foundry business, a level we view as justified and is slightly higher than tier-2 makers due 
to Made in U.S. advantages; 2) 20x our 2028E EPS of its Design business, which is lower than the 
target multiple assigned to its peers’ such as AMD, as we believe its Design business is still losing 
shares in server and part of the earnings is to fund its Foundry segment. Overall , we project its ROE 
will recover to an above 10% level by 2028E amid the trend of Made in U.S.  
Intel’s P/B traded at an average of 1. 8x post pandemic when the new “IDM 2.0” and “5Y4N” strategy 
rolled out, though it didn’t really execute. Share price was volatile in the past few years due to events 
of: 1) multiple delays in leading technologies; 2) inferior financial performance of IFS; 3) mgmt. changes; 
4) weak position against TSMC. However, its P/B valuation moved up following the U.S. government’s 
stake purchase in Aug 2025. We expect the upward trend to continue, and our target price is at the high 
end of its cycle valuation, as we believe the New CEO Li p-Bu Tan’s initiatives with financial discipline 
and process technology development to remake Intel will enhance the company’s position in the 
industry. We believe the critical factors to watch will be Intel’s progress of 18A and 14A.

4Q26 半導體產業展望 
BSPDN 與 VPD 升級供電架構 
結論與建議 
1. Backside Power Delivery Networks (BSPDN)於 4Q26 正式進入量產階段。BSPDN 將電
源線路由晶圓正面移至背面 ， 降低供電阻抗與壓降 ， 並釋放正面訊號布線空間 。 台積電A16
將於 4Q26 導入 Super Power Rail量產，Intel 18A 已採 PowerVia，Samsung SF2Z 則預
計 27 年導入 BSPDN，晶背供電正由技術驗證進入量產與滲透率提升階段。 
2. AI XPU 功耗與供電電流快速上升後，封裝端供電瓶頸由主機板延伸至高電流傳輸路徑。  
Vertical Power Delivery (VPD)透過將電壓調節模組由 XPU 側邊移至下方，縮短低壓大電
流的供電距離並改善損耗與供電穩定性 。ASE powerSiP 可將配線功率損耗由 12%降至 6%、
電流密度由 0.4A/mm²提升至 0.6A/mm²；Meta 亦已完成 850A AI ASIC VPD模組驗證，
顯示 VPD 正由封裝平台驗證逐步進入 AI 晶片實際導入階段。 
3. SEMICON T aiwan 2026 顯示，VPD 正由單一供電方案升級為 AI 先進封裝核心架構。隨
VRM 逐步靠近 XPU，電容及其他被動元件亦同步向封裝內整合，台積電 CoWoS-L 已導
入 eDTC， 日月光亦展示CAP Module 等方案 。 未來先進封裝價值將由RDL、TSV 與 HBM
互連，進一步延伸至供電、被動元件及散熱整合，推升 OSAT 單顆 AI 封裝價值量。 
4Q26 投資展望 
1. 展望 4Q26，AI 供電架構將由傳統主機板與晶圓正面供電，逐步轉向 BSPDN 與 VPD。台積
電(2330 TT)A16 將導入 Super Power Rail(SPR)晶背供電並於 4Q26 量產，新增晶圓接合、極薄
化、CMP、晶背蝕刻、薄膜沉積及檢測量測等製程，帶動單片晶圓設備與耗材價值提升。台股供
應鏈中，中砂(1560 TT) 受惠 CMP 製程與鑽石碟耗材需求增加，昇陽半導體(8028 TT) 則受惠設
備調機、製程驗證及量產監控所帶動的再生晶圓需求。 
2. 封裝端 4Q26 則將由 VPD 技術驗證逐步轉向客戶導入與前量產準備。隨 AI 處理器供電需求
朝 1,000A 以上發展，VPD 已成為 AI 先進封裝的重要架構。日月光投控(3711 TT)powerSiP 透
過將電壓調節模組移至 XPU 下方縮短供電路徑 ， 未來封裝價值可望由RDL、TSV 與 HBM 互連 ，
進一步延伸至電壓調節模組、矽電容、eDTC、嵌入式被動元件及散熱整合。

投資 顧問 
產業報告

3 
A16 於 4Q26 量產，晶背供電由技術藍圖正式進入製造端 
隨 AI 與高效能運算晶片朝更高電晶體密度與功耗發展，先進製程瓶頸已由電晶體微縮延伸至供
電架構。傳統邏輯晶片的訊號與電源皆由晶圓正面傳輸，隨製程持續微縮，金屬線寬縮小推升互
連電阻，電源線路亦與訊號線路競爭有限的布線空間，使壓降與布線壅塞逐步限制晶片效能。晶
背供電網路(BSPDN)則將電源線路移至晶圓背面，訊號仍由正面傳輸，再透過垂直導通結構將電
力送至電晶體附近，不僅可降低供電阻抗與壓降，也能釋放正面布線空間，進一步改善效能、功
耗與邏輯密度，成為 GAA 之後延續先進邏輯製程微縮的重要技術。  
BSPDN 的製程會先以一片厚度約 600 微米的矽晶圓為基底 ， 於其上方建構出約100 奈米厚度的
電晶體層，再於其上方堆疊約500 奈米厚度的訊號導線區。與傳統製程不同，此階段僅需構築訊
號導線，不再同時建立電源線。這是因為晶背供電架構中，電源分配網路將改由晶圓背面實現。
當訊號線區完成後 ， 需將整片晶圓與另一片厚度同樣為600 微米的矽晶圓進行 Wafer Bonding，
該上方晶圓即為承載晶圓(Carrier Wafer)。此步驟的目的，是在隨後進行背面加工時提供機械支
撐。由於後續將進行極端薄化，晶圓本體厚度會從 600 µm 減至僅剩電晶體層，此時原晶圓結構
已喪失剛性，若無外部支撐，無法承受設備夾持、搬運與後段製程的熱機應力。接著晶圓會進入
研磨與化學機械平坦化(CMP)階段，將原始矽基底完全去除，僅保留前段製成的電晶體層。此時
晶圓已被翻轉，即原本的背面朝上。接著透過矽穿孔技術，在電晶體底部開孔，以建立背面供電
通道，並於其上沉積 500 奈米的電源金屬層，完成晶背供電的製程。

圖一. Backside Power Delivery Networks Process

資料來源：Intel，國泰證期研究部整理

從競爭格局來看，晶背供電亦正由個別業者的差異化技術，逐步轉為全球先進邏輯製程的標準競
爭項目。Intel 已於 18A 導入 PowerVia，Samsung 亦規劃於 SF2Z 導入 BSPDN 並於 27 年進入
量產。隨台積電 A16 於 4Q26 正式量產，先進製程競爭將由過去 GAA 電晶體結構本身，進一步
延伸至晶背供電架構、製程整合能力及量產良率。研究部認為 4Q26 將是 BSPDN 由技術驗證轉
向量產驗證的重要分水嶺，27 年則有望進一步進入客戶滲透率與晶圓投片量擴張階段。

### Page 4

投資 顧問 
產業報告

4 
圖二：Backside Power Delivery Networks (BSPDN)

資料來源：IMEC、國泰證期研究部整理

VPD 縮短高電流供電路徑，powerSiP 提升 AI 封裝供電效率 
若 BSPDN 解決的是晶片內部供電問題，垂直供電(Vertical Power Delivery，VPD)則聚焦於電力
進入封裝前的高電流傳輸路徑。傳統 AI 加速器通常將電壓調節模組配置於 XPU 周邊，電流需沿
主機板或封裝基板水平傳輸後再進入處理器。隨 AI XPU 功耗及瞬時電流需求持續提高，部分下
一代 AI 處理器供電需求已達數百安培甚至 1,000 安培以上，高電流將明顯放大配線損耗、供電
網路阻抗及電壓波動，供電架構因而逐步成為限制 AI 晶片效能的重要因素。VPD 的核心概念，
是將原本位於 XPU 側邊的電壓調節模組移至 XPU 正下方，使低壓、大電流的傳輸路徑由公分級
水平配線縮短至毫米級垂直路徑，進而降低線路電阻及配線損耗，並改善瞬時負載變化下的供電
穩定性。同時供電元件由 XPU 周邊移至下方後，亦可釋放封裝邊緣空間予 HBM、高速輸入輸出
及其他 Chiplet，使供電架構開始直接影響 AI 封裝設計。 
日月光投控 powerSiP 為目前 OSAT 端具代表性的 VPD 平台之一，透過系統級封裝將多級電壓
調節模組及被動元件垂直整合於 SoC 或 Chiplet 下方 ， 使電源可由封裝底部以較短路徑直接供應
至運算晶片。SEMICON T aiwan 2026 展示數據顯示，相較傳統水平並排式架構，powerSiP 可
將配線功率損耗由 12%降低至 6%，電流密度由 0.4A/mm²提高至 0.6A/mm²，封裝平面占用面
積則縮小約 25%。其技術價值主要來自縮短供電距離及提高垂直整合程度，而非僅依賴電源晶片
本身的轉換效率提升。

5 
VPD 的產業成熟度亦正由封裝平台驗證逐步向實際 AI 晶片應用推進。Meta 於 APEC 2026 發表
850A AI ASIC 垂直供電模組，輸出電壓為 0.85V，採兩級供電架構，電流密度達 0.8A/mm²，並
已完成設計、製造及電性與散熱驗證。隨 AI ASIC 及 GPU 所需電流持續提高，研究部預期 VPD
後續競爭重點將由單純電源轉換效率，進一步延伸至單位面積電流密度、封裝高度、散熱能力、
瞬時響應速度及封裝面積。 
先進封裝由訊號互連走向供電整合，OSAT 價值量持續提升 
SEMICON T aiwan 2026所反映的重要產業變化，在於 VPD 已由單一封裝技術逐步轉為 AI 先進
封裝的核心設計參數。日月光投控於本屆論壇將 VPD 與超過 1,000A 的 AI 處理器、HBM 配置
及封裝內電壓調節整合放在同一技術架構下 ， 顯示先進封裝的功能正由過去以RDL、TSV、Chiplet
及 HBM 高速互連為主，進一步延伸至供電、電源完整性及散熱管理。 
隨電壓調節模組逐步靠近 XPU，封裝內被動元件的重要性亦同步提高。高功耗 XPU 在運算負載
快速切換時，需要鄰近的去耦電容即時提供瞬時電流，因此供電元件向運算晶片靠近的同時，電
容及其他被動元件亦需同步向封裝內部整合。台積電 CoWoS-L 已可於 SoC 下方整合 eDTC 以
改善電源完整性；日月光本次 SEMICON 亦同步展示 CAP Module 及 FOCoS-Bridge 等技術，
反映 AI 先進封裝正由單純訊號整合，逐步轉向訊號、供電與被動元件共同整合。 
未來 AI 封裝中的供電相關內容 ， 預期將不再侷限於電壓調節模組 ， 而可進一步涵蓋電源級晶片 、
矽電容、eDTC、MIM 電容、整合式磁性元件及嵌入式被動元件。隨 AI XPU 功耗提高，供電效
率、電源元件配置及散熱架構將逐步成為高階封裝的重要差異化來源，單顆 AI 封裝的價值量亦
有望由原有晶粒組裝與高速互連持續向供電整合延伸。 
圖三：ASE PowerSiP

資料來源：ASE、國泰證期研究部整理 
研究部認為，VPD 對 OSAT 產業的結構性意義，在於先進封裝開始承擔部分過去由主機板負責
的供電功能。若 VPD 後續於 AI GPU 及客製化 ASIC 的滲透率提高，OSAT 的角色將由傳統封裝
測試及互連服務，進一步升級為涵蓋運算、記憶體、供電及散熱的系統整合平台，並帶動單顆高
階 AI 封裝的供電相關價值量持續提升。

產業報告

4Q26 晶背供電與垂直供電帶動晶片架構升級 
研究部認為 ，AI 半導體下一階段的技術瓶頸將由運算效能與記憶體頻寬進一步延伸至供電架構 。
隨 AI XPU 功耗、封裝尺寸及供電電流同步提高，傳統由晶圓正面及主機板進行長距離供電的架
構，逐步面臨壓降、傳輸損耗及布線空間不足等限制，促使產業分別由晶片與封裝兩端縮短供電
路徑。晶圓端以 BSPDN 將電源線路由晶圓正面移至背面，降低供電阻抗並釋放正面訊號布線空
間；封裝端則透過 VPD 將電壓調節模組由 XPU 側邊移至下方，縮短低壓大電流的傳輸距離。隨
兩項技術逐步落地，Power Delivery 將由過去的電源零組件問題，進一步成為先進製程及先進封
裝共同面對的半導體架構議題。 
晶圓代工端最明確的 4Q26 催化劑為台積電(2330 TT)A16 進入量產。A16 將奈米片 GAA 與
Super Power Rail(SPR)晶背供電整合，代表 BSPDN 正式由技術開發階段進入商業製造。相較
傳統先進製程僅持續增加前段製程複雜度，晶背供電在正面製程完成後，還需額外進行晶圓接
合、極薄化、晶背蝕刻、平坦化、介電層與金屬層形成，以及後續檢測，因此新增的是一整段
晶背加工流程。隨 A16 於 4Q26 量產，先進製程設備需求的成長來源將不僅來自 2 奈米以下晶
圓投片量提高，單片晶圓所需的製程步驟及耗材使用量亦將同步增加，其中化學機械平坦化
(CMP)、晶圓薄化、蝕刻、薄膜沉積、晶圓接合及檢測量測均為主要受惠環節。 
台股供應鏈中，中砂(1560 TT)與昇陽半導體(8028 TT）可望受惠 BSPDN 導入。中砂主要受惠
晶背薄化與平坦化需求增加，BSPDN 對背面平坦度、厚度均勻性與表面品質要求提高，將推升
CMP 製程與耗材使用量；中砂透過 PYRADIA 系列鑽石碟切入先進 CMP 市場，受惠來源除先
進製程投片成長外，亦包括單片晶圓 CMP 製程步驟增加。昇陽半導體則受惠晶背製程增加所帶
動的測試與監控晶圓需求。隨晶背薄化、研磨、蝕刻、沉積與平坦化等製程增加，設備調機、
製程驗證及量產監控所需再生晶圓同步提升。憑藉再生晶圓加工與精密拋光能力，昇陽半導體
有望受惠先進製程複雜度提高所帶來的再生晶圓需求成長。 
4Q26 VPD 的產業重點將由技術可行性驗證逐步轉向客戶導入與前量產準備。ASE powerSiP 雖
已於 24 年推出，但 SEMICON T aiwan 2026顯示，隨下一代 AI 處理器供電需求朝 1,000A 以上
發展，VPD 已由單一電源封裝方案升級為 AI 先進封裝的重要架構選項；Meta 於 APEC 2026 完
成 850A AI ASIC 垂直供電模組的設計、製造及電性與散熱驗證，也顯示大型雲端業者已開始將
VPD 納入實際 AI ASIC 供電設計。因此 4Q26 是 VPD 由平台開發進入客戶驗證、設計導入及量
產準備的重要階段，而非大規模出貨起點。對OSAT 而言，隨 VPD 將電壓調節模組由 XPU 側邊
移至下方，先進封裝的價值來源亦將由過去以RDL、TSV、Chiplet 及 HBM 高速互連為主，逐步
延伸至供電與電源完整性；若 VPD 於 AI GPU 及客製化 ASIC 的滲透率提高，封裝內新增內容可
望進一步涵蓋電壓調節模組、矽電容、eDTC、嵌入式被動元件及散熱結構，使日月光投控(3711 
TT)等 OSAT 業者由傳統封裝測試與互連服務，逐步轉向運算、記憶體、供電與散熱的系統整合
平台，並帶動單顆高階 AI 封裝價值量持續提升。

中碳 1723 TT  ( 化學工業 ) 
碳材料成長仍待觀察 
投資與評價 
1. 2026 年煤化學本業自低點復甦，受惠油價與苯、雜酚油及軟瀝青等產
品報價回升。碳材料仍為中長期成長主軸，高功率 LIB 負極已切入 BBU
應用。 
2. 目前多數產品仍處客戶驗證階段，500 噸 ACS 與 240 噸等方性石墨新
產能預計 2027 年初投入，但客戶需求狀況仍待觀察。預估 2026/2027
年 EPS 分別為 3.61/3.50 元。 
3. 考量煤化學本業復甦已逐步反映，但碳材料與石墨坩堝商業化進度較原
先預期保守，且 2027 年獲利尚未呈現明顯成長，將 FY27E 本益比評價
由 27 倍下調至 26 倍，目標價由 95 元調整至 91 元（26x FY27E 
EPS），投資評等調整至中立。

重點更新 
2Q26 煤化學利差改善，獲利明顯優於原估 
2Q26 營收 20.42 億元（+59.8% QoQ） ，較原估上修29.1%，主要受到 3 月
後油價、苯價上漲，帶動煤焦油與輕油系列產品售價提高，且產品價格上漲
速度快於原料成本；毛利率 22.6%（-2.4ppts QoQ） ，較原估高2.7ppts，營
益率 14.9%（+0.7ppt QoQ） ， 較原估高4.2ppts， 稅後淨利3.02 億元 （+68.7% 
QoQ），EPS 1.27 元為近一年新高。2Q26 獲利大幅優於原估，主要反映煤化
學產品價格與原料成本間的有利價差，但隨原料成本於季末逐步上升，後續
營收與獲利成長幅度將趨緩。 
2027 碳材料進入商業化窗口，但放量時程仍待觀察 
2027 年營收預估 70.90 億元 （+5.1% YoY） ，毛利率22.0%（-0.7ppt YoY），
營業利益 8.63 億元（-1.1% YoY） ，稅後淨利8.29 億元（-3.2% YoY），EPS 
3.50 元（-3.0% YoY） 。傳統煤化學本業預估維持相對穩定，成長重點轉向碳
材料，500 噸 ACS 第一期與 240 噸等方性石墨新產能均預計 2027 年初投
入，分別切入EDLC、HSC/LIC 與 SiC 半導體應用；惟目前多數產品仍處客戶
驗證階段，日本 HSC/LIC 客戶新廠亦延至 1Q27，考量大量供貨時間尚未明
確，因此對 2027 年碳材料實際獲利貢獻採較看待。

2026 煤化學本業復甦，新碳材料進入客戶驗證期 
2026 年營收預估 67.46 億元 （+15.2% YoY） ，較原先預估64.02 億元上修 5.4%，主要反映上半
年油價與煤化學產品價格回升，帶動苯、雜酚油及軟瀝青等傳統本業自 2025 年低點復甦；毛利
15.31 億元 （+38.1% YoY） ，較原估上修17.9%，毛利率 22.7%（+3.8ppts YoY） ，較原估20.3%
高 2.4ppts。 營業費用6.58 億元 （+14.7% YoY） ， 較原估上修9.9%， 費用率9.8%（-0.4ppt YoY）；
營業利益 8.73 億元（+62.9% YoY） ，較原估上修24.8%，營益率 12.9%（+3.8ppts YoY） 。業
外收益 1.67 億元，使稅後淨利 8.56 億元（+39.0% YoY） ，較原估上修26.4%，EPS 3.61 元
（+36.2% YoY）為近三年新高。2026 年主要獲利來源仍為煤化學本業，碳材料營收占比仍低，
但高功率 LIB 負極已切入 BBU 應用，ACS 正進行韓國 EDLC 客戶驗證，HSC/LIC 則與日本指標
客戶進行材料驗證及下一代產品共同開發，仍處於驗證與商業化準備期。

2027 碳材料進入商業化窗口，第二成長曲線靜待發酵 
2027 年營收預估 70.90 億元（+5.1% YoY） ，與原估70.94 億元大致持平；毛利 15.62 億元
（+2.0% YoY） ，較原估上修1.6%，毛利率 22.0%（-0.7ppt YoY） ，較原估高0.4ppt，主要考量
部分產油設施的安全衝擊，將使煤化學報價仍將維持一定水平，但碳材料增長仍有限。營業費用
6.99 億元（+6.2% YoY） ，較原估上修4.6%，費用率 9.9%，因碳材料研發與新產能投入仍持續
加大；營業利益 8.63 億元（-1.1% YoY） ，與原估8.69 億元大致相當，營益率 12.2%。業外收益
1.76 億元，使稅後淨利 8.29 億元（-3.2% YoY），EPS 3.50 元低於前一年。2027 年傳統煤化學
本業預估維持相對穩定，碳材料開始由驗證轉向產能與客戶同步商業化；ACS 新廠第一期與 240
噸等方性石墨產能均預計於 2027 年初投入，分別切入 EDLC、HSC/LIC 及 SiC 半導體市場，其
中日本 HSC/LIC 客戶新廠亦延至 1Q27 完成，但考量大量供應客戶的時間點仍未定，因此 2027
年的獲利成長來自於碳材料仍有待觀察。

2027 芳烴結構轉緊與碳材料放量 結構升級帶動獲利回升 
2027 年營收 70.94 億元（成長 YoY）與原先預估大致持平，碳材料客戶訂單能見度仍未見提
升；毛利 15.37 億元（成長 YoY） ，毛利率 21.7%（+1.4ppts YoY）回升；營業費用 6.68 億
元（+11.5% YoY） ， 費用率 9.4%； 營業利益 8.69 億元 （+24.1% YoY） ， 營益率 12.2%（+1.3ppts 
YoY） ；稅後淨利 8.33 億元（+23.0% YoY），EPS 3.52 元。展望 2027 年，芳烴市場在供給成
長受限與需求持續回升下，預期將由平衡轉為偏緊，苯與輕油產品價格中樞有望進一步上移，甲
苯亦受調油與化工需求支撐維持強勢 ， 帶動產品利差擴大 ； 同時公司成長動能來自AI 伺服器 BBU
應用，包含 EDLC 與 LIC 產品於 2026–2027 年逐步導入量產。等方性石墨與 SiC 半導體材料進
入驗證後期，2027 年有望開始貢獻營收，以及中國石墨材料出口管制與去中化趨勢下，台灣在
地供應鏈角色提升，有機會擴大市占並切入北美市場。

煤化學本業復甦，碳材料放量時程轉趨保守 
2026 年受惠油價與煤化學產品價格回升 ， 苯 、 雜酚油及軟瀝青利差改善 ， 帶動本業自2025
年低點復甦，預估 2026 年 EPS 3.61 元（+36.2% YoY） ；惟2Q26 較佳利差環境已逐步
正常化，2027 年煤化學本業以穩定為主。中長期成長動能仍來自碳材料，高功率 LIB 負
極已切入 BBU 應用，ACS、HSC/LIC 及等方性石墨則分別切入 EDLC、AI 伺服器電力備
援與 SiC 半導體市場，500 噸 ACS 第一期與 240 噸等方性石墨新產能預計 2027 年初投
入；然而目前多數產品仍處客戶驗證階段，石墨坩堝亦尚未進入明確大量供貨階段，因此
相較前次報告 ， 對碳材料2027 年放量進度轉趨保守 。 預估2026/2027 年 EPS 為 3.61/3.50
元。目前中碳股價 83.6 元約為 24X 27(F)PER，於近五年歷史本益比合理區間 16~34X 中
間偏下位置，考量 2027 年營運持穩，但碳材料方面的需求能見度仍待觀察，給予中間偏
上位置 ，將本益比評價由先前 27 倍(調整前 FY27E EPS)調整至 26 倍(調整後 FY27E EPS)，
目標價 91 元(27x 調整後 FY27E EPS)，投資評等調整至中立。

公司簡介 
中碳為國內特用化學品業者 ， 也是中鋼的子公司 ， 產品線較其他國內同業分散 ， 原料多來自中鋼 、
中龍煉焦爐製造過程中產出的煤焦油、輕油廢棄物。以目標市場作分析，中碳約有 45%的外銷
品，該類產品具有較高附加價值，其餘55%則以內銷為主，也因為內需為主要市場，在台灣類似
的石油副產品加工角色並不多，主要的波動與競爭還是跟隨國際原物料的價格調整。料源的主要
供應之一越南鋼廠，隨著疫情的緩解，使得主要原料供應也將逐步增加，目前煤焦油約為 26 萬
噸(六座高爐)， 輕油則有12 萬噸(約當 8 座高爐)。 苯的主要應用包含石化業 、 家電與電腦外殼等 ，
市場以台灣為主。 
從中碳的產品結構來看，煤焦油、輕油、焦炭、界相碳微球分別占比 46%、28%、10%、5%。
從流程來看自中鋼生產流程中煉焦產生輕油、煤焦油，再由中鋼管線及越鋼運送至中碳。而中碳
再從輕油煉製成苯，煤焦油則煉製成軟瀝青、雜酚油、精奈。苯為SM 上游原料，雜酚油則是碳
黑、木材防腐油原料，軟瀝青則是電極棒原料(煉鋼與煉鋁)、電池碳芯黏結劑、屋頂防水防蝕原
料，萘則是用於染料中間體、驅蟲萘丸等。

ESG 可加強處 
供應商及產品生命週期管理 (SASB 重大性議題，製造業排行 81%) 
環境面供應鏈管理方面，中碳制定綠色供應鏈管理政策，於遴選供應商過程中考量供應商環境管
理表現，優先選用已取得環保等相關認證之新供應商，並要求其填寫「供應商評估管理項目問卷
暨稽核表」 及 「不使用衝突礦區聲明書」 。建議定期稽核供應商環境管理成效，揭露查核數據且輔
導不合格之廠商。法規遵循方面，2021 年未違反環境汙染相關法規。 
董事會結構與運作 (製造業排行 75%) 
董事會結構與運作方面，中碳揭露董事及管理階層的接班規劃。董事會定期評估會計師獨立性，
亦訂定規範禁止內部人利用公司內部訊息於有價證券市場獲利。獨立董事方面，中碳獨立董事席
次未達董事席次二分之一以上，建議提升獨立董事席次，以強化董事會監督功能。

法說會重點摘要

光聖 
(6442 TT, NT$ 1,800, 未評等)

重點摘要  
1. 公司 1H26 營收 63.9 億元， YoY 27% ，毛利率 59.5% ，EPS 
19.07 元；2Q26 毛利率進一步升至 62%，主因高芯數產品拉貨
較多。營收結構以資料中心光被動產品為主，約占 80% ，RF 連
接器占 10-15%、光主動占 5%；地區上約 90%營收來自歐美 。 
2. 公司表示 2H26 營收原則上仍將優於 1H26 ，2026 年底前訂單已
大致在手，但光纖原料自 2026 年初供給吃緊、供應商新產能要
到 2027 年才開出，目前產能滿載，出貨受限於原料取得量。  
3. 產品芯數由 1-2 年前的 288 芯為主，升級至目前主力 864-6912
芯，13824 芯 2026 年仍在試產、 2027 年開始有量，公司認為
3456 芯以上目前僅公司能開發。長期另布局 CPO 相關應用、
DOCSIS 與低軌衛星高頻連接器，以及醫療、太空國防等光機電
整合應用 。 
結論 
我們認為光 聖的毛利率 隨高芯數產品比重逐年提升、 6912 芯出貨已具
規模，加上 13824 芯 2027 年起量，使 2026/2027 年全年 營收與 毛利
率有機會 持續成長 。短期而言，營收成長的限制在光纖原料供給而非
需求，2H26 增幅將取決於原料分配與 GDR 購料資金到位的時點。

營運概況與財務表現  
 2025 年營收 105 億元，YoY 64% ；毛利率由 2023 年 35.55% 升
至 2025 年 57.74% ，EPS 由 2023 年 2.53 元增至 23.46 元 
 1H26 營收 63.9 億元，YoY 27% ；毛利率由 1H25 的 56.53% 提升
至 59.5% ，EPS 19.07 元（1H25 為 6.85 元） 
 高芯數產品比重由 2 年前不到 5 成升至 1H26 的 5 成，產品組合改
善為毛利率提升主因  
 負債比由 1H25 約 59%降至 1H26 的 31.99% ，主因 2025 年發行
的 2 檔 CB 已於 2026 年初全數轉換完成，銀行借款亦隨之減少；
ROE 約 3 成，1H26 每股淨值 166 元

高芯數產品與 AI 資料中心布局  
 目前主力產品為 Patch Panel 、Cassette 與 Torpedo Cable ，客戶為
美系 AI 資料中心業者，過去 2 年累計出貨的光纖長度可繞地球
150 圈

 芯數由 1-2 年前以 288 芯為主，提升至目前主力 864 、1728 、
3456 與 6912 芯；6912 芯 2025 年已有相當出貨量， 13824 芯
2026 年仍在試產， 2027 年開始有量  
 6912 芯毛利率高於 864 芯，但出貨數量較少；新產品量少時毛
利率無法拉到正常水準，放量後高芯數高毛利的趨勢將顯現  
 公司認為 3456 芯以上目 前僅公司能開發， CPO 上線後高芯數、
高規格需求將持續增加  
 資料中心採高低配，並非全面採用高芯數；升級時資料中心基礎建
設本身不太更換，主要更換機櫃內光纖， AI 需求擴大時可能由 288
芯直接升級至 864 芯 
 定價依客戶需求、長度與應用客製，無法以芯數倍數換算， 864 芯
不會是 288 芯的 3 倍，公司以保障毛利率為定價原則  
 Scale -up 方面，公司以光纖、機構件與光耦合 know-how 由外往內
延伸至 CPO 相關應用，已提供樣品給終端客戶

光纖原料供給與擴產規劃  
 光纖原料自 2026 年初開始吃緊，供應商擴產預計 2027 年才開
出；公司目前兩班制生產且產能滿載，有需要時以加班支應，三班
制除非產能真的不足才會採用  
 原料上漲一律即時反映給客戶， 1H26 至今均已反映，毛利率未因
原料上漲而下降  
 美系資料中心業者已主動與原料供應商談定份額，並依給公司的訂
單量要求供應商分配原料； 2027 年原料亦將與終端客戶共同向光
纖廠與連接器廠商談定  
 寧波、菲律賓、台灣場地皆足夠，產能規劃增加 20-30%，實際擴
產幅度取決於原料供應；三地產線配置、流程與設備一致，可彈性
調度產能 
 長期將先導入半自動化再朝自動化，以因應寧波與台灣工廠的招工
問題

客戶轉型 與全球生產布局  
 公司 1977 年由 CATV 連接器起家，過往光主動主要客戶為中國大
廠 ， 中 國 供 應 鏈 崛 起 後 退 出 該 市 場 並 轉 往 歐 美 ， 營 收 來 源 由 約
70%來自中國轉為目前 90%來自歐美 
 生產據點含台灣、中國寧波、菲律賓、捷克與美國，布局考量地緣
政治、美國在地設廠稅務與貼近客戶  
 台灣：1.5 個工廠生產資料中心產品，依客戶要求做 security 隔
離；0.5 個工廠生產傳統連接器  
 寧波：由過往光主動產品轉為主要生產光被動資料中心產品  
 菲律賓：自有廠於 7M25 正式運作，生產光主動與光被動產品  
 捷克：前身為英飛凌先進封裝部門，生產精密 封裝治具與當地
NRE 案件，為公司切入光通訊高精密封裝的技術來源

QA 
 2H26 與 2027 年營運展望為何？  
 往年 2H 營收動能高於 1H，2H26 原則上仍優於 1H26 ；7-8M26
營收已公告， 3Q26 不會太差， 4Q26 仍在觀察

 美系資料中心業者公布的投資顯示 2027 年持續成長，公司將依
客戶需求擴產  
 2Q26 毛利率 62%能否作為後續基準？  
 2Q26 高芯數產品拉貨較多，毛利率超過 6 成；是否為常態難以
判斷，各季由客戶依布建規劃做高低芯數搭配  
 高 芯 數 比 重 逐 年 增 加 ，2026 年 全 年 毛 利 率 有 機 會 高 於2025
年；毛利率超過 6 成為公司內部努力目標  
 GDR 的發行規劃為何？  
 發行量為 400-500 萬股，已獲主管機關核准，將待股價相對有
利時才發行  
 GDR 折價率多在 95-100 之間，約 1-2%讓利，對股權結構不會
有太大影響  
 將洽歐美與中東主權基金等大型機構參與，使股權結構更完整並
提升國際能見度  
 月營收起伏較大應如何解讀？  
 客戶依案場布建時程調整拉貨，單月波動屬正常，應看平均； 1-
8M26 累計營收 92 億元，月均約 10-12 億元，YoY 將近 4 成 
 大廠 CAPEX 與公司營收為何不對稱？  
 CAPEX 投入到公司營收之間有時間差，兩者方向一致但比例不
同 
 CAPEX 由多家供應商分享，分配量取決於能提供的規格與交期  
 是否擔心資料中心案場建置延宕？  
 目前未遇到此問題，客戶持續穩定要求出貨  
 與合聖科技（ 7928 TT）的合作進度？  
 合作持續進行，光聖持續協助並共同開發其產品；合聖已掛牌，
